tasks.name: Emergency Evacuation
steps:
Activate terminal
• The terminal takes five seconds to activate. Once this step appears, Helldivers will be also able to use the SSSD Delivery stratagem ( ). It is recommended to use the stratagem as it will be required for a later step.

Log in to terminal
• On the terminal, enter the five long directional input code.

Use Terminal to open SSSD Delivery Hatch
• On the terminal, press to open the SSSD hatch.

Call down SSSD and insert into Hatch
• Use the SSSD Delivery stratagem if it hasn't been used and deliver the SSSD to the hatch. The hatch is located at the base of a communication tower within the sub-objective.

Use terminal to align communication signal
• On the terminal, use directional inputs to raise the signal strength to 100%.

Use Terminal to activate Communication Tower
• On the terminal, enter the five long directional input code to complete the sub-objective.
tasks.tactical_info: Helldivers are advised to take these factoids into consideration when placing some of the trickier defensive Stratagems If using Mortar Sentries (both High Explosive and EMS ), it is recommended to place these closer to the Shuttle Bay entrance to possibly allow more pre-emptive clearing around the edges of the emergency evacuation port area. Depending on the direction where enemies spawn and enter the evacuation zone, it is possible to use mine field stratagems to block the entrances, While Tesla Towers won't specially target civilians, they can still end up being used as conduits for chain arcing. Therefore, Tesla Towers should be placed over 20-meters away from the evacuation paths. Planets with the Fire Tornado environmental hazard can prove deadly to citizens. Helldivers should pay attention to their timings of citizen evacuations if the hazard is active. A Helldiver killing 9 Civilians will be branded as a Traitor . And the Super Destroyer will fire 380mm HE Shells at the Helldiver until they are killed.
steps_zh:
启动终端
• 终端启动需要五秒。一旦此步骤出现，绝地潜兵将也能使用 SSSD 运输战略配备。建议使用该战略配备，因为后续步骤会需要它。

登录终端
• 在终端上输入五位长方向输入代码。

使用终端打开 SSSD 运输舱门
• 在终端上按下方向键以打开 SSSD 舱门。

呼叫 SSSD 并放入舱门
• 如尚未使用，使用 SSSD 运输战略配备，将 SSSD 送到舱门。舱门位于子目标内通信塔的底部。

使用终端对齐通信信号
• 在终端上使用方向输入将信号强度提升至 100%。

使用终端激活通信塔
• 在终端上输入五位长方向输入代码以完成子目标。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 绝地潜兵在放置某些棘手的防御型战略配备时应考虑以下要点：如果使用迫击哨戒炮（高爆和电磁冲击波两种），建议将其放置在更靠近穿梭舰停机坪入口的位置，以便在紧急撤离港口区域的边缘进行更多先发制人的清剿。根据敌人从哪个方向生成并进入撤离区域，可以使用地雷战略配备封锁入口。特斯拉塔虽然不会专门瞄准平民，但仍可能成为电弧连锁传导的导体，因此应放置在距离撤离路径 20 米以上的地方。带有火焰龙卷风环境危害的行星可能对市民构成致命威胁。如果该危害生效，绝地潜兵应注意平民撤离的时机。一名绝地潜兵若杀死 9 名平民，将被标记为叛徒，超级驱逐舰将向其发射 380mm 高爆弹，直到其被击杀。

tasks.name: Evacuate High-Value Assets
steps:
Prepare your defenses. Time left until automatic initiation begins: [01:30]
• Helldivers have 1 minute and 30 seconds to call in Stratagems and prepare for the oncoming onslaught. Afterwards, the 20 minute mission timer starts.
• Helldivers may initiate the evacuation of high-value assets early by interacting with the terminal, then using the up and right directional inputs to enable Power, Fuel, and Engines on said terminal.

Defend generators until all rockets have launched. Rockets launched: 0/8
• Helldivers must now defend the 2 generators in the area.
• A rocket will be launched every 1 minute and 45 seconds. Including the initial preparation window, this means the mission will complete 15 minutes and 30 seconds after dropping in, making the mission's overall 20-minute timer somewhat misleading.
Reward: 500 Experience & 100 Requisition Slips
tasks.tactical_info: General Information [ edit | edit source ] The area is divided into 2 sections. The outer wall has 2 doors, 1 for each direction the enemies can come from, and 1 inner wall with 1 door. These doors may be closed to slow down enemies or opened to retrieve Equipment from outside and let Helldivers back in. There are multiple E/MG-101 HMG Emplacements already stationed, though they will have less than half of their total ammo. 2 behind the outside wall and 2 behind the inside wall. Supplies can be found around the area. Certain Support Weapons can be found in specific spots. The overall mission area is small, making large-scale strategems such as the Orbital 380mm HE Barrage kill teammates more often than not. When building a loadout, it is recommended to look at teammates' loadouts and select stratagems that will work well with theirs. For example, if the A/ARC-3 Tesla Tower has been selected by one Helldiver, it is not recommended to bring an overtly destructive strategem such as the Eagle 500kg Bomb . Stratagems with short cooldowns such as the EAT-17 Expendable Anti-Tank , MD-6 Anti-Personnel Minefield , or MLS-4X Commando find more value in this mission, due to the relatively short mission time. On a similar note, the Orbital Laser Strategem can be used far more liberally in this mission for the same reason. Closing the gate nearest the Generators can prevent any stealthy enemies from sneaking by the defensive line. When the Generators are actively being damaged, an alarm will sound. Automaton Information [ edit | edit source ] Helldivers should bring Sentries , Emplacements , and anti-tank support weapons to deal with Tanks and Factory Strider cannon turrets in addition to Difficulty appropriate Stratagems . Hard for example will have multiple Hulks . An E/AT-12 Anti-Tank Emplacement can easily down most of the Dropships , resulting in smaller enemy waves that can be mopped up by a Mortar or Autocannon sentry. Alternatively, two Helldivers performing an Assisted Reload with a GR-8 Recoilless Rifle and a steady supply of Resupplies can work similarly. On Suicide Mission and above, Factory Striders which are being dropped into the battlefield should be prioritized, as destroying the Dropship before they can drop the Factory Strider on the ground will instantly kill it. Downed Dropships can crush the Defense Gates very easily. Gunships will never spawn, unless the Gunship Patrols Operation Modifier is active. Terminid Information [ edit | edit source ] If a Charger rams into any gate, it will instantly collapse. Utilizing fire weaponry, such as the Eagle Napalm Airstrike or MD-I4 Incendiary Mines can shut down bug breaches before they even become a problem. Stalkers will never spawn in this mission, unless the Predator Strain is active on the planet. Likewise, Shriekers will never spawn, unless the Roving Shriekers Operation Modifier is active. Standing too close to the edge of the battlements can cause Hunters to fly up and deal damage, even if the gates are closed. Illuminate Information [ edit | edit source ] Leviathans will never target the generators directly, but can still destroy them through collateral damage. Harvesters pose the highest threat of any enemy barring the Stingray due to their extremely powerful long-range laser beams that can instantly destroy generators and kill Helldivers. Therefore, their demise must be met upon arrival. The E/MG-101 HMG Emplacement excels on Illuminate missions, due to its ability to tear through every enemy's armor (excluding the Leviathan). It is especially useful for taking down Stingrays. Elevated Overseers will oftentimes fly over the battlements, ignoring the gates completely. As such, they are considered high-priority targets. The RL-77 Airburst Rocket Launcher is extremely beneficial on Illuminate missions as the wide AoE cluster explosions can single-handedly clear hordes of Voteless , Overseers , and Fleshmobs with a single rocket. It is recommended to bring the RL-77 Airburst Rocket Launcher over the Eagle Cluster Bomb as it is not limited by cooldown, only supplies.
steps_zh:
准备防御。自动启动前剩余时间：[01:30]
• 绝地潜兵有 1 分 30 秒呼叫战略配备并为即将到来的攻势做准备。之后，20 分钟的任务计时开始。
• 绝地潜兵可以提前开始撤离高价值资产：与终端交互，然后使用上和右方向输入在该终端上启用电力、燃料和引擎。

保护发电机，直到所有火箭发射完毕。已发射火箭：0/8
• 绝地潜兵现在必须保护区域内的 2 台发电机。
• 每 1 分 45 秒发射一枚火箭。包括初始准备窗口，这意味着任务将在落地后 15 分 30 秒完成，使得任务的总 20 分钟计时略显误导。
奖励：500 经验与 100 申购点
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 一般信息：区域分为两个部分。外墙有 2 扇门，每个敌人来袭方向各一扇，内墙有 1 扇门。这些门可以关闭以减缓敌人，或打开以取回外部的装备并让绝地潜兵返回。区域内已部署多座 E/MG-101 重机枪部署支架，但弹药不足总量的一半——外墙后 2 座，内墙后 2 座。附近可以找到补给。某些支援武器出现在特定位置。任务区域整体较小，因此轨道 380mm 高爆弹火力网等大规模战略配备往往更容易误杀队友。配置装备时，建议查看队友的装备并选择能与之配合的战略配备。例如，若一名绝地潜兵选择了 A/ARC-3 特斯拉塔，则不建议携带飞鹰 500kg 炸弹等破坏性过强的战略配备。由于任务时间相对较短，EAT-17 一次性反坦克火箭、MD-6 反步兵雷区或 MLS-4X 突击兵等冷却时间短的战略配备在本任务中更有价值。同理，轨道激光炮战略配备在本任务中可以更自由地使用。关闭最靠近发电机的门可以防止潜行敌人偷偷穿过防线。当发电机正被攻击时，会响起警报。机器人信息：绝地潜兵应携带哨戒炮、部署支架和反坦克支援武器，以应对坦克和移动工厂的加农炮炮塔，并配合与难度相符的战略配备。例如困难难度会有多台巨型者。E/AT-12 反坦克炮台可以轻松击落大部分运输舰，从而产生更小的敌波，可用迫击哨戒炮或机炮哨戒炮清理。或者，两名绝地潜兵用 GR-8 无后坐力炮进行协助装填，并配合稳定的补给，也能起到类似效果。自杀任务及以上难度，应优先处理正在空投的移动工厂，因为在它们落地前摧毁运输舰可直接击杀它们。被击落的运输舰很容易压垮防御大门。除非启用炮舰巡逻行动修正，否则炮舰永远不会生成。终结族信息：如果强袭虫撞击任何大门，大门会立即坍塌。利用火焰武器，如飞鹰凝固汽油弹空袭或 MD-I4 燃烧地雷，可以在虫洞爆发前将其压制。除非星球上激活掠食变种，否则追踪虫永远不会在本任务中生成。同样，除非启用游荡尖啸虫行动修正，否则尖啸虫不会生成。站得太靠近城垛边缘可能被猎手飞扑造成伤害，即使大门关闭也是如此。光能族信息：利维坦永远不会直接瞄准发电机，但仍可能通过附带伤害摧毁它们。猎杀器构成除刺魟以外最大的威胁，因为它们极其强大的远程激光束可以瞬间摧毁发电机并击杀绝地潜兵。因此，它们一出现就必须被消灭。E/MG-101 重机枪部署支架在光能族任务中表现出色，因为它能撕开每个敌人的护甲（利维坦除外），尤其适合对付刺魟。悬浮监察者经常飞越城垛，完全无视大门，因此被视为高优先级目标。RL-77 空爆火箭弹发射器在光能族任务中极为有利，其大范围集束爆炸可以单发火箭清掉成群的无票者、监察者和肉瘤体。建议优先携带 RL-77 空爆火箭弹发射器而非飞鹰集束炸弹，因为它不受冷却限制，只受补给限制。

tasks.name: Launch ICBM
steps:
Find the hard disk containing the Launch Codes.
• Helldivers must go to the Human Structure (3 variations; Excavation, Junkyard, ) and find the Launch Codes. It is a blue-ish, big rectangle. It emits a constant sound of static and morse code, getting louder the closer the Helldiver is to the Disk containing the Codes.
steps_zh:
找到包含发射代码的硬盘
• 绝地潜兵必须前往人类建筑（3 种变体：挖掘场、废料场等）并找到发射代码。它是一个偏蓝色的大矩形，会持续发出静电和摩斯电码的声音，距离包含代码的硬盘越近声音越大。

tasks.name: Retrieve Valuable Data
steps:
Activate terminal
• Helldivers must interact with the terminal to power it on.

Use terminal to log in to research database
• Helldivers must interact with the terminal if not already, and then put in the 5 direction code.

Use terminal to initiate emergency data backup
• Helldivers must interact with the terminal if not already, and then press the up direction.

Database downloading
• Helldivers must wait the entire 20 seconds it takes for this step to complete.

Use terminal to eject SSSD Hard Drive
• Helldivers must interact with the terminal, then input the 7 direction code

Collect the SSSD Hard Drive
• Helldivers must go to the SSSD Hard Drive container and interact witth the SSSD Hard Drive to pick it up

Transport SSSD Hard Drive to Communications relay
• Helldivers must now hold onto the SSSD Hard Drive and transport it to the Communications relay.

(If the SSSD Hard Drive has been dropped) Recover the dropped SSSD Hard Drive
• Helldivers must pick up the dropped SSSD Hard Drive again
steps_zh:
启动终端
• 绝地潜兵必须与终端交互以将其通电。

使用终端登录研究数据库
• 绝地潜兵若尚未交互，需与终端交互，然后输入 5 位方向代码。

使用终端启动紧急数据备份
• 绝地潜兵若尚未交互，需与终端交互，然后按下上方向。

数据库下载中
• 绝地潜兵必须等待此步骤完成的整个 20 秒。

使用终端弹出 SSSD 硬盘
• 绝地潜兵必须与终端交互，然后输入 7 位方向代码。

拾取 SSSD 硬盘
• 绝地潜兵必须前往 SSSD 硬盘容器并与 SSSD 硬盘交互以将其拾起。

将 SSSD 硬盘运送到通信中继站
• 绝地潜兵现在必须拿住 SSSD 硬盘并将其运送到通信中继站。

（如果 SSSD 硬盘被掉落）找回掉落的 SSSD 硬盘
• 绝地潜兵必须再次拾起掉落的 SSSD 硬盘。

tasks.name: Spread Democracy
steps:
(If no Helldiver is within the 25-meter range) Move closer to objective
• Helldivers must move closer to the objective location.
Use Stratagem: SUPER EARTH FLAG

Flag Raising
• Helldivers must wait and defend the flag from constant Bug Breaches/Bot Drops the entire one minute and forty seconds until the objective is complete.
• Enemies near the objective must be all killed once the flag has fully raised to complete the objective.
• Should all Helldivers leave the area of the flag before the objective is completed, the flag's progress will begin reversing.
steps_zh:
（如果没有绝地潜兵在 25 米范围内）靠近目标
• 绝地潜兵必须向目标位置靠近。
使用战略配备：超级地球旗帜

升旗中
• 绝地潜兵必须等待并防守旗帜，抵御持续的虫洞爆发/机器人空投，持续 1 分 40 秒直到目标完成。
• 旗帜完全升起后，必须杀光目标附近的所有敌人才能完成任务。
• 若所有绝地潜兵在任务完成前离开旗帜区域，旗帜进度将开始倒退。

tasks.name: Start Fuel Pumps
steps:
Activate terminal
• Upon reaching the fueling station, Helldivers will encounter a small amount of enemies guarding the fueling station.
• After clearing the area, Helldivers must activate the terminal by interacting with it. Then, Helldivers must adjust the fueling route to move fuel from the Local Storage to the Missile Silo; the up and down directional inputs will swap the current pipe in the highlighted column.

Log in to terminal
• The Helldivers must input the directional code as seen on the terminal.

Redirect fuel to new target
• On the terminal screen, the Helldivers must create a pipeline from the fuel output (left) to the new target (top right).
• To do so, they must press " " or " " to move the pipes up and down. And press " " and " " to move from side to side.
tasks.tactical_info: Enemies will continuously spawn and patrol near the fueling station if the mission has yet to be completed. It is recommended that Helldivers conceal themselves as they complete the objective, or to quickly dispatch nearby patrols if necessary.
steps_zh:
启动终端
• 到达燃料站后，绝地潜兵会遇到少量守卫燃料站的敌人。
• 清理区域后，绝地潜兵必须通过交互启动终端。然后，绝地潜兵必须调整燃料路线，将燃料从本地储罐输送到导弹发射井；上和下方向输入会交换高亮列中当前的管道。

登录终端
• 绝地潜兵必须输入终端上显示的方向代码。

将燃料改道至新目标
• 在终端屏幕上，绝地潜兵必须建立从燃料输出口（左侧）到新目标（右上）的管道。
• 为此，他们必须按（上）（下）方向键上下移动管道，按（左）（右）方向键左右移动。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 如果任务尚未完成，敌人会持续在燃料站附近生成并巡逻。建议绝地潜兵在完成任务时隐藏自己，或必要时迅速解决附近的巡逻队。

tasks.name: Terminate Illegal Broadcast
steps: Locate broadcast tower

Login required
• Input the arrow code to gain access.

Raise signal strength to 100%
• Align the signal to 100% to shut down the broadcast.
Reward: 200 Requisition Slips , 50 Experience
tasks.tactical_info: Instead of shutting down the broadcast with the terminal, the tower itself can be destroyed with any source of Demolition equal to or higher than 30 to instantly complete the objective. Examples include most grenades , the AC-8 Autocannon , GL-21 Grenade Launcher , and R-36 Eruptor . Any part of the tower except the mounted screens and speakers will trigger its destruction when hit. Most offensive Stratagems such as the Orbital Gatling Barrage and Eagle Strafing Run will work as well. Ramming the tower's base with a vehicle like the M-102 Fast Recon Vehicle , TD-220 Bastion MK XVI , or any Exosuit will also destroy it.
steps_zh: 定位广播塔

需要登录
• 输入箭头代码以获取访问权限。

将信号强度提升至 100%
• 将信号对齐到 100% 以关闭广播。
奖励：200 申购点、50 经验
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 除了用终端关闭广播外，塔本身也可以用任何拆毁值达到或超过 30 的武器摧毁，从而立即完成任务。例如大多数手榴弹、AC-8 机炮、GL-21 榴弹发射器和 R-36 爆裂铳。塔的任何部位（除安装的屏幕和扬声器外）被击中都会触发其摧毁。轨道加特林攻击和飞鹰机枪扫射等大多数攻击型战略配备也有效。用 M-102 快速侦察载具、TD-220 堡垒 MK-XVI 或任何外骨骼装甲撞击塔基也能将其摧毁。

tasks.name: Upload Escape Pod Data
steps:
Use Upload Data stratagem to begin upload
• The stratagem becomes available when within 30 meters of the crash site.
• It has the following code:

Protect (Helldiver) during upload
• (Helldiver) is the username of whoever began the upload.
• The upload will take 40 seconds. If the uploader dies or leaves the 30 meter radius, the upload progress will drain.
tasks.tactical_info: Beginning the upload process will reset the enemy reinforcement cooldown. Enemies will never spawn near the crashed escape pod. This makes it a good candidate for an initial drop location if it is visible during mission briefing.
steps_zh:
使用上传数据战略配备开始上传
• 该战略配备在距离坠机地点 30 米内时可用。
• 其代码为：

上传期间保护（绝地潜兵）
• （绝地潜兵）是开始上传者的用户名。
• 上传需要 40 秒。如果上传者死亡或离开 30 米半径，上传进度会流失。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 开始上传过程会重置敌方增援冷却。敌人永远不会在坠毁的逃生舱附近生成。如果在任务简报中可见，这使其成为不错的初始降落点候选。

tasks.name: Activate Oil Pumps
steps:
Activate terminal
• Helldivers must interact with the terminal

Log in to terminal
• Helldivers must interact with the terminal if not already, and input the 7-direction code shown on the screen

Redirect oil to Transfer Station
• Helldivers must interact with the terminal if not already and use the direction buttons to move pipes in a pipe puzzle until oil Outflow connects with Transfer Station instead of Local Storage, and then wait 2 seconds.

Turn all valves indicated by the terminal
• Helldivers must interact with all 3 valves scattered across the entire area If a valve is gunked up, it needs to be shot free first This gunk cannot be removed with "non-directed"-attacks such as Arc Damage produced with E.G. ARC-12 Blitzer or ARC-3 Arc Thrower Helldivers trying to free a valve from Terminid influence should stand clear, else they will be violently flung into the air. Melee weapons such as CQC-30 Stun Baton have enough reach to safely remove the gunk. Helldivers must interact with the valve, then hold the right direction until the Helldiver has spun the valve counterclockwise twice, and it emits a green light Spinning it clockwise twice until it emits a red light closes the valve instead

Use terminal to reactivate pumps
• Helldivers must go back to the terminal, interact with it, and then use the up direction to complete this step

Oil pumps activating
• Helldivers must wait for the entire 10 seconds it takes to complete this step
Reward: 500 Requisition Slips and 100 Experience
steps_zh:
启动终端
• 绝地潜兵必须与终端交互。

登录终端
• 绝地潜兵若尚未交互，需与终端交互，并输入屏幕上显示的 7 位方向代码。

将石油改道至转运站

tasks.tactical_info: The tops of the towers are often wider than their base, creating a significant overhang. Helldivers should take care when calling in a NUX-223 Hellbomb to ensure the hellpod does not get stuck on the tower when called in. While possessing significantly more health than a regular Shrieker Nest , like all Terminid structures they have almost no armour and can be destroyed via any source of sustained damage from range. They require a demo force of 50 to destroy outright. The Patriot and Emancipator Exo-suits are ideal for this, although doing so will deplete their ammo reserves. The TD-220 Bastion MK XVI can destroy a single tower with either 4 shots, or 3 shots with the main gun and ~66 shots from the coaxial HMG. The M-1000 Maxigun has excellent sustained-fire capability against the Terminid structures, and is perhaps the best support weapon to bring down a tower quickly, ammo notwithstanding. When using the allocated NUX-223 Hellbomb to destroy the tower, be wary of any nearby Civilians and SEAF Troopers , as their lack of situational awareness means they do not have the sense to avoid its massive blast.

tasks.tactical_info: Bug holes at the drilling locations can be easily closed by driving into them. When beginning the mining process, be careful not to be in the way of the arm of the GATER , as it will launch the player when rotating. The Ground All-Terrain Extraction Rig will self-destruct in a huge explosion after completing its task (akin to a Hellbomb ). The Ground All-Terrain Extraction Rig can be destroyed, it can take a lot of damage, but it's susceptible to Hellpods crashing into it, as well as Bile Titans stepping on it, or a Hive Lord emerging from under it. It is highly advised to deal with the Hive Lord before commencing operation of the GATER, as the Hive Lord can fling it out of the map by surfacing under it, immediately failing the mission. Two Helldivers can man the vehicle at the same time, one driver and a gunner. When the driver exits the vehicle, he will stand on top of it and can stay there, while someone else gets into the driver seat and moves it around. (This way the full squad can get onto and into the vehicle.) The mounted Autocannon is similar to the one on the EXO-49 Emancipator Exosuit and has limited ammunition, but doesn't need a manual reload.

tasks.tactical_info_zh: 钻井地点的虫洞可以通过驾车冲入轻松关闭。开始采矿过程时，小心不要挡在 GATER 机械臂的行进路线上，因为它在旋转时会抛飞玩家。地面全地形提取装置（GATER）在完成任务后会以巨大的爆炸自毁（类似于地狱火炸弹）。GATER 可以被摧毁，它能承受大量伤害，但容易因地狱舱撞入、吐酸泰坦踩踏或霸王虫从下方钻出而受损。强烈建议在开始操作 GATER 之前先解决霸王虫，因为霸王虫可以从下方浮出将其抛离地图，立即导致任务失败。两名绝地潜兵可以同时操控车辆：一名驾驶员和一名炮手。驾驶员离开车辆时会站到车顶并能留在那里，同时其他人进入驾驶座移动车辆（这样整个小队都能登上并进入车辆）。车载机炮与 EXO-49 解放者外骨骼上的类似，弹药有限，但无需手动装填。

tasks.tactical_info: Closing up bug holes will lessen the steady flow of enemies present in the mission. Taking time to close them can be considered if the squad has the extra time to spare. It’s highly recommended to destroy the multiple Spore Spewers found across the map to increase physical visibility. In rare instances, Terminids appear close or directly beneath the Tectonic Drill. Placing an FX-12 Shield Generator Relay before deploying the Tectonic Drill near it will prevent this. However, Bile Titans can pose a threat since it will now attempt to spew Bile on the Energy Shield Relay, which would be close to the Tectonic Drill. If your squad has spare Dark Fluid Vessel , have them dropped and available near the small “islands” leading up to the Extraction Zone to help navigate towards Extraction quicker. Using an EXO-45 Patriot Exosuit or EXO-49 Emancipator Exosuit can help with closing bug holes and dealing with waves of light armored bugs that appear more often in this mission type. Incidentally, being inside the mech when the Tremors appear after finishing the last Tectonic Drill objective will give a nice head-start towards Extraction as you won’t be slowed down. After the objective is completed, massive amounts of Shriekers will start to attack Helldivers after a brief Tremor and will continue to spawn, infinitely. One Strategy that can help when extracting is spending extra time placing several Supply Drops near the Extraction Zone before finishing the last drill. These boxes can help provide precious Stims and Grenades to help protect the squad from the massive amounts of Shriekers. Smoke Stratagems and the G-3 Smoke are excellent when dealing with the massive Shrieker wave that appears near the Extraction Zone. A continuous well-timed screen of smoke can help lessen the amount of attacks the squad receives from the Shriekers, which can be done with G-3 Smoke grenades if the Extraction zone was prepared with Resupplies . Staying Prone also helps dodge Shrieker attacks while other members of the squad are doing the Terminal.

tasks.tactical_info_zh: 关闭虫洞会减少任务中敌人的持续涌入。如果小队有富余时间，可以考虑花时间关闭它们。强烈建议摧毁地图上散布的多座孢子喷射者以提高可见度。在极少数情况下，终结族会出现在构造钻机附近或正下方。在部署构造钻机前在其附近放置一个 FX-12 防护罩生成中继器可以防止这种情况。然而，吐酸泰坦可能构成威胁，因为它现在会尝试将酸液喷吐到靠近构造钻机的能量护盾中继器上。如果小队有备用暗流容器，可将它们投放到通往撤离区的小“岛”附近，以帮助更快地前往撤离。使用 EXO-45 爱国者外骨骼或 EXO-49 解放者外骨骼有助于关闭虫洞并处理这种任务中更频繁出现的轻甲虫群。顺便一提，在完成最后一个构造钻机目标后地震出现时，待在机甲内可以让你快速冲向撤离点，因为不会被减速。目标完成后，短暂地震后大量尖啸虫会开始攻击绝地潜兵，并无限持续生成。一个可行的撤离策略是在完成最后一个钻机前，花额外时间在撤离区附近放置多个补给。这些箱子可以提供宝贵的兴奋剂和手榴弹，帮助小队抵御大量尖啸虫。烟雾战略配备和 G-3 烟雾弹在应对撤离点附近出现的巨量尖啸虫波次时表现出色。持续恰到好处的烟雾屏可以帮助减少小队受到的尖啸虫攻击次数，如果撤离点已用补给准备好，可以用 G-3 烟雾手榴弹实现。在队友操作终端时保持卧姿也有助于躲避尖啸虫攻击。

• The Helldiver must stay inside the radius and survive for the entire 40 second duration of the upload.
tasks.tactical_info: Research probes tend to be located within the area of influence produced by Terminid Structures (E.G. Bug Nests ) and other secondary objectives. Starting the upload process without fully securing the surrounding area beforehand triggers Bug Breaches throughout the upload duration.
steps_zh: 使用上传数据战略配备开始上传

上传期间保护（绝地潜兵姓名）
• 绝地潜兵必须留在半径内并在整个 40 秒上传期间存活。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 科研探测器往往位于终结族建筑（例如虫巢）和其他次要目标的影响范围内。若未事先充分清理周边区域就启动上传过程，会在整个上传期间触发虫洞爆发。

tasks.name: Nuke Nursery
steps:
Find the nursery chamber drill point.
• Helldivers must locate the drill point within a large circular area.
• The nursery chamber spawns where the ground appears infested.
• The nursery chamber may be located visually by a large amount of unmarked Bug Holes , and appears on the map as a circular clearing.

Call in Hive Breaker Drill
• After inputting a stratagem code, the drill will be delivered via Pelican in a large casing, after reaching the surface it will unpack itself and reveal a terminal.

Activate Hive Breaker Drill
• Helldivers must input a 5-direction code to activate the drill.

Defend the drill
• The drilling process will begin and the drill must be defended, if damaged too severely the drilling process will fail.

Use drill interface to deploy Nuclear Payload.
• Requires a single up-direction press on the terminal.

Evacuate the area.
• The drill will detonate after 10 seconds.
tasks.tactical_info: Failing the drill defense will return the drill to the initial deactivated state, instead of destroying it. The drill may retain up to 50% of previous total progress when re-activated. After detonation, a very deep crater will be left in the terrain, falling in this crater kills the Helldiver. The Orbital EMS Strike is a very effective strategem for this mission, as it can nearly freeze Terminids attempting to destroy the Drill.
steps_zh:
找到育巢室的钻探点。
• 绝地潜兵必须在一个大型圆形区域内定位钻探点。
• 育巢室在地面看起来被感染的地方生成。
• 可以通过大量未标记的虫洞在视觉上定位育巢室，并在地图上显示为圆形空地。

呼叫巢穴破坏钻机
• 输入战略配备代码后，钻机将由鹈鹕用大型外壳运送，到达地面后它会自行展开并露出一个终端。

激活巢穴破坏钻机
• 绝地潜兵必须输入 5 位方向代码来激活钻机。

保护钻机
• 钻探过程将开始，必须保护钻机，如果受损过重，钻探过程将失败。

使用钻机界面部署核载荷。
• 只需在终端上按一次上方向。

撤离该区域。
• 钻机将在 10 秒后引爆。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 钻机防御失败会使钻机回到初始未激活状态，而不是将其摧毁。重新激活时，钻机最多可保留先前总进度的 50%。引爆后，地形上会留下一个很深的弹坑，掉入该弹坑会击杀绝地潜兵。轨道电磁冲击波攻击是本任务非常有效的战略配备，因为它几乎可以冻结试图摧毁钻机的终结族。

tasks.name: Purge Hatcheries
steps: [ edit | edit source ] Destroy Eggs [ edit | edit source ] “ Large quantities of eggs are located in this area. Use any means necessary to destroy them. — Mission Briefing
tasks.tactical_info: The Eggs are fragile, numerous, and found in clusters. Helldivers are advised to bring Weapons and Stratagems that deal explosive damage, such as the CB-9 Exploding Crossbow , R-36 Eruptor , GL-21 Grenade Launcher , AC-8 Autocannon or the Eagle Airstrike . A single B-100 Portable Hellbomb or Eagle 500kg Bomb can destroy all the eggs in the nest. Since the Eggs can't take much damage before being destroyed, the FLAM-40 Flamethrower is an efficient choice. While Helldivers are able to destroy eggs with bare-handed melee damage, the bursting eggs create a shockwave sending a Helldiver into fatal impact-damage. Fortunately even short-range melee-weapons such as CQC-5 Combat Hatchet and CQC-30 Stun Baton have long enough reach to dispose eggs without the risk of being expulsed.
steps_zh: 摧毁卵：“该区域存放着大量卵。使用任何必要手段摧毁它们。——任务简报”
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 这些卵脆弱、数量众多且成簇出现。建议绝地潜兵携带造成爆炸伤害的武器和战略配备，例如 CB-9 爆燃弩、R-36 爆裂铳、GL-21 榴弹发射器、AC-8 机炮或飞鹰空袭。单枚 B-100 便携式地狱火炸弹或飞鹰 500kg 炸弹即可摧毁巢内所有卵。由于卵在摧毁前无法承受太多伤害，FLAM-40 火焰喷射器是个高效选择。虽然绝地潜兵能用徒手近战伤害摧毁卵，但爆裂的卵会产生冲击波，将绝地潜兵推向致命的撞击伤害。幸运的是，即使是 CQC-5 战斗斧和 CQC-30 眩晕警棍等短程近战武器也有足够的攻击距离，可以在不被弹飞的风险下处理卵。

tasks.name: Restart Pumps
steps:
Purge site of Terminid Matter
• There are exactly 8 or 10 Terminid Matter to destroy It takes 6 melee hits to destroy 1 The Terminid Matter covers the pumps themselves, the pipes, as well as the valve

Adjust pipe valves
• A single valve in the area has to be turned
Reward: 500 Requisition Slips and 100 Experience
steps_zh:
清除场地的终结族物质
• 恰好有 8 或 10 个终结族物质需要摧毁。6 次近战命中可摧毁 1 个。终结族物质覆盖泵本身、管道以及阀门。

调整管道阀门
• 必须转动区域内的单个阀门。
奖励：500 申购点和 100 经验

tasks.name: Restore Air Quality
steps:
This Terminid hive node emits a dense fog which reduces visibility.
• Helldivers must locate all Spore Spewers on the map and destroy them by any means necessary.
tasks.tactical_info: The stats of these Spore Spewers are the same as those found when they are a secondary objective, and so are weak to the same weapons & tactics. The location of Spore Spewers in this mission is always approximate, as indicated by the large circle around them on the map (similar to the Poor Intel modifier.) If you can spot the structure directly, pinging it for your team will update the map with its exact location. There will be bug holes around the Spore Spewer, but clearing these is unnecessary to complete the mission.
steps_zh:
这个终结族蜂巢节点会散发出降低能见度的浓雾。
• 绝地潜兵必须找到地图上所有的孢子喷射者并用任何必要手段摧毁它们。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 这些孢子喷射者的属性与作为次要目标出现时相同，因此对相同的武器与战术有效。本任务中孢子喷射者的位置总是近似确定的，由地图上环绕它们的大圆圈指示（类似情报不足修正）。如果你能直接看到该结构，为队友标记它会在地图上更新其精确位置。孢子喷射者周围会有虫洞，但清理这些虫洞并非完成任务所必需。

tasks.name: Annex Untapped Mineral Sites
steps:
Obtain coordinates
• Collect the device on the ground in the Automaton encampment
steps_zh:
获取坐标
• 收集机器人营地地面上放置的设备。

tasks.name: Blitz Search And Destroy/Automaton
tasks.name_zh: 闪电战：搜索并摧毁（机器人）
steps:
Find and destroy any active Automaton fabricators
• A random number of Automaton fabricators must be destroyed.
Reward: Before multipliers, between 375 and 1250 Requisition Slips , and between 75 and 250 Experience depending on the difficulty.
tasks.tactical_info: Due to the presence of Automatons and the low duration of the mission, it's an excellent choice for a Solo Super Sample run Because this mission is about locating Automaton Fabricators, it is recommended to bring Stratagems and Weapons capable of destroying them. Especially those capable of destroying them from very long range, such as: The LAS-99 Quasar Cannon or GR-8 Recoilless Rifle can destroy fabricators on impact from long distances. Eagle Strafing Runs and Eagle Airstrikes can destroy Fabricators very easily.
steps_zh:
找到并摧毁任何活跃的机器人制造机
• 必须摧毁随机数量的机器人制造机。
奖励：倍数之前，根据难度为 375 至 1250 申购点，以及 75 至 250 经验。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 由于机器人的存在和任务时间短，这是单人超级样本跑图的绝佳选择。由于本任务的核心是定位机器人制造机，建议携带能够摧毁它们的战略配备和武器，尤其是能在极远距离摧毁的：LAS-99 类星体加农炮或 GR-8 无后坐力炮可以从远距离命中并摧毁制造机。飞鹰机枪扫射和飞鹰空袭可以非常轻松地摧毁制造机。

tasks.name: Blitz: Destroy Bio-Processors
tasks.name_zh: 闪电战：摧毁生物处理器
steps:
Destroy the bio-processors (up to 5 per objective)
• The Helldivers must destroy the specified number of bio-processors in order to complete the objective.
tasks.tactical_info: As the Bio-Processors are completely unarmored, they are vulnerable to all Helldiver weaponry , including basic small arms fire. Confrontation with the Automaton Outpost can be easily avoided if a Helldiver is able to throw a high-damaging Stratagem near the Bio-Processors, such as an Eagle 500kg Bomb . Similarly to other Optional Objectives that require Helldivers to destroy a structure, a Hellbomb stratagem is provided to Helldivers when in close proximity to the Bio-Processors. While this method allows Helldivers to destroy the Bio-Processors without using any of their own munitions or Stratagems, it takes substantially longer to call in and arm the Hellbomb than if a Helldiver were to use other means of destruction. A Hellpod has enough Demolition Force to destroy a Bio-Processors, which is easy to achieve by throwing a Stratagem Ball (of something that comes in a Hellpod) in the gap between the two parts of a Bio-Processors, such as the provided Hellbomb Stratagem. A single well-placed Flak mode rocket from the RL-77 Airburst Rocket Launcher can destroy 2 bio-processors as well as a couple enemies. Bio-Processors can also be destroyed with a single shot from the GP-20 Ultimatum or a TED-63 Dynamite throwable.
steps_zh:
摧毁生物处理器（每个目标最多 5 个）
• 绝地潜兵必须摧毁指定数量的生物处理器才能完成任务。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 由于生物处理器完全没有护甲，它们容易受到所有绝地潜兵武器（包括基础轻武器火力）的伤害。如果绝地潜兵能在生物处理器附近投掷高伤害战略配备（例如飞鹰 500kg 炸弹），则可以轻松避免与机器人前哨的正面冲突。与其他需要绝地潜兵摧毁结构的可选目标类似，当绝地潜兵接近生物处理器时会提供地狱火炸弹战略配备。虽然这种方法允许绝地潜兵不使用自己的弹药或战略配备就摧毁生物处理器，但呼叫和武装地狱火炸弹的时间比使用其他破坏手段要长得多。一个地狱舱具有足够的拆毁值来摧毁生物处理器，只需在生物处理器的两半之间的空隙投掷战略配备球（用于任何乘地狱舱降落的东西，例如提供的地狱火炸弹战略配备）即可轻松实现。RL-77 空爆火箭弹发射器的一发布置得当的破片模式火箭可以摧毁 2 个生物处理器以及几个敌人。生物处理器也可以用 GP-20 最后通牒或 TED-63 炸药投掷物一发摧毁。

tasks.name: Commando: Acquire Evidence
steps: Helldivers must secure the Tactical Video Camera for use. It will be marked on Helldiver's maps and placed inside an already dropped Hellpod .
tasks.tactical_info: The Tactical Video Camera occupies a Helldiver's Support Weapon slot. It is recommended to designate one squad member to not bring a Support Weapon in their loadout, instead carrying the camera. To use the camera, Helldivers must first equip it by pressing the Support Weapon key, then hold down the aim and fire keys. The camera will have a short charge-up, then start recording. This shown by a visible red light and an audible tape rolling sound. To properly record the incriminating evidence, Helldivers must have a clear line of sight to the target. To complete the mission, Helldivers are required to extract with the camera. Extracting without the camera will result in mission failure. Once picked up, the camera will be constantly marked on all Helldiver's maps.
steps_zh: 绝地潜兵必须取得战术摄像机以供使用。它会被标记在绝地潜兵的地图上，并放置在已降落的地狱舱内。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 战术摄像机占用绝地潜兵的支援武器槽位。建议指定一名小队成员在装备中不携带支援武器，改为携带摄像机。要使用摄像机，绝地潜兵必须先按支援武器键装备它，然后按住瞄准和开火键。摄像机会有短暂的充能，然后开始录制。这通过可见的红光和可听见的磁带转动声表示。要正确录下不利证据，绝地潜兵必须对目标有清晰的视线。要完成任务，绝地潜兵必须携带摄像机撤离。不带摄像机撤离将导致任务失败。拾起后，摄像机将一直标记在所有绝地潜兵的地图上。

tasks.name: Commando: Extract Intel
steps:
Helldivers must search one or more Automaton Outpost in search for a keycard.
• The keycards bear a resemblance to the Launch Codes found in Launch ICBM .
tasks.tactical_info: The intel package will require Helldivers to constantly hold it in one hand, restricting weapon use to one-handed weapons only. To complete the mission, Helldivers are required to extract with the intel package. Extracting without the black box will result in mission failure. Once picked up, the intel package will be constantly marked on all Helldiver's maps. Note that preemptively destroying the antenna will destroy the entire structure, rendering the intel package unable to be picked up, resulting in mission failure.
steps_zh:
绝地潜兵必须搜索一个或多个机器人前哨，寻找钥匙卡。
• 钥匙卡与发射洲际弹道导弹任务中发现的发射代码相似。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 情报包要求绝地潜兵始终用一只手拿着它，将武器使用限制为仅限单手武器。要完成任务，绝地潜兵必须携带情报包撤离。不带黑匣子撤离将导致任务失败。拾起后，情报包将一直标记在所有绝地潜兵的地图上。请注意，抢先摧毁天线会摧毁整个结构，使情报包无法拾取，导致任务失败。

tasks.name: Commando: Secure Black Box
steps: Find the downed SEAF recon aircraft
Collect the BLACK BOX
Extract with Black Box
tasks.tactical_info: The black box will require Helldivers to constantly hold it in one hand, restricting weapon use to one-handed weapons only. To complete the mission, Helldivers are required to extract with the black box. Extracting without the black box will result in mission failure. Once picked up, the black box will be constantly marked on all Helldiver's maps. The Collect Black Box objective is the same as the secondary objective in the Retrieve Recon Craft Intel mission.
steps_zh: 找到坠毁的 SEAF 侦察机
拾取黑匣子
携带黑匣子撤离
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 黑匣子要求绝地潜兵始终用一只手拿着它，将武器使用限制为仅限单手武器。要完成任务，绝地潜兵必须携带黑匣子撤离。不带黑匣子撤离将导致任务失败。拾起后，黑匣子将一直标记在所有绝地潜兵的地图上。拾取黑匣子目标与取回侦察艇情报任务中的次要目标相同。

tasks.name: Confiscate Assets
steps: Call down the Cargo Container stratagem.
Load Fusion Batteries into Cargo Container. (the number required is equal to the current difficulty level plus 1)
A Pelican ship will take away the Cargo Container when it's full.
tasks.tactical_info: Fusion batteries are extremely dangerous and fragile. They will explode if damaged. Helldivers need to be extremely careful when handling them. Press the left mouse button / right trigger to throw the platinum bar forward a short distance, making transportation more convenient.
steps_zh: 呼叫货物集装箱战略配备。
将聚变电池装入货物集装箱。（所需数量等于当前难度等级加 1）
货物集装箱装满后，鹈鹕飞机会将其带走。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 聚变电池极其危险且易碎。如果受损它们会爆炸。绝地潜兵在处理它们时必须极其小心。按鼠标左键/右扳机可将铂条向前抛出一小段距离，使运输更方便。

tasks.name: Destroy Command Bunkers
steps: Call down, arm and defend a Hellbomb until it detonates and destroys the bunker.
tasks.tactical_info: The bunker is armed with fusion turrets & casemates protected by Automaton units, including small pockets further away from the main structure. The fusion turrets & casemates can target Helldivers from long-range unprovoked, so it is advised to be aware of the turrets at all times. Since they can prove to be a nuisance it is advised to use Heavy armor penetrating support weapons such as the AC-8 Autocannon or PLAS-45 Epoch to destroy them from range. They can also be completely disabled by completing the Compromise Automaton Defenses optional objective. The main structure of the bunker is encased in Anti-Tank II armor so only Anti-Tank weapons with Anti-Tank II armor penetration such as the EAT-17 Expendable Anti-Tank and GR-8 Recoilless Rifle can damage it. Be sure to aim at the actual bunker itself and not the walls. The EAT-411 Leveller , FAF-14 Spear , MS-11 Solo Silo , and TD-220 Bastion MK XVI main gun can destroy the bunker in 1 shot. The EAT-17 Expendable Anti-Tank, LAS-99 Quasar Cannon , GP-20 Ultimatum , and GR-8 Recoilless Rifle can destroy the bunker in 2 shots. The B/MD C4 Pack and G-123 Thermite need only 2 charges to destroy. The E/AT-12 Anti-Tank Emplacement and EXO-51 Lumberer Exosuit cannon can destroy the bunker in 3-4 shots, depending on range. The EXO-45 Patriot Exosuit 's rockets and the MLS-4X Commando can destroy the bunker in 4 shots.
steps_zh: 呼叫、武装并保护一枚地狱火炸弹，直到它引爆并摧毁地堡。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 地堡配备了聚变炮塔和装甲炮座，由机器人单位保护，主结构更远处还有小股敌人。聚变炮塔和装甲炮座会无缘无故地从远距离瞄准绝地潜兵，因此建议始终注意炮塔。由于它们可能成为麻烦，建议使用 AC-8 机炮或 PLAS-45 纪元等重甲穿透支援武器从远距离摧毁它们。完成削弱机器人防御可选目标也可以完全禁用它们。地堡的主体结构覆盖着反坦克 II 护甲，因此只有具有反坦克 II 护甲穿透的反坦克武器（如 EAT-17 一次性反坦克火箭和 GR-8 无后坐力炮）才能对其造成伤害。务必瞄准地堡本身而非墙壁。EAT-411 荡平者、FAF-14 飞矛、MS-11 单兵导弹发射井和 TD-220 堡垒 MK-XVI 主炮可以 1 发摧毁地堡。EAT-17 一次性反坦克火箭、LAS-99 类星体加农炮、GP-20 最后通牒和 GR-8 无后坐力炮可 2 发摧毁。B/MD C4 背包和 G-123 铝热弹只需 2 个即可摧毁。反坦克炮台和 EXO-51 伐木者外骨骼加农炮可根据射程 3-4 发摧毁。EXO-45 爱国者外骨骼的火箭和 MLS-4X 突击兵可 4 发摧毁。

tasks.name: Destroy Transmission Network
steps: Destroy Antenna Transmitters
tasks.tactical_info: Transmitters plates can be individually destroyed with small arms fire. Explosive weapons such as the CB-9 Exploding Crossbow , R-36 Eruptor or AC-8 Autocannon are most effective for destroying multiple transmitters in a single shot. Optionally the whole tower itself can be destroyed with explosive demolition force, such as the LAS-99 Quasar Cannon . This will also destroy the transmitters itself.
steps_zh: 摧毁天线发射器
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 发射器面板可以用轻武器火力单独摧毁。CB-9 爆燃弩、R-36 爆裂铳或 AC-8 机炮等爆炸武器对单发摧毁多个发射器最为有效。可选地，整个塔本身可以用爆炸性拆毁力摧毁，例如 LAS-99 类星体加农炮。这也会一并摧毁发射器。

tasks.name: Eliminate Automaton Factory Strider
steps: [ edit | edit source ] Eliminate Factory Strider [ edit | edit source ] “ Orbital infrared scans have detected a Factory Strider in this area. — Objective Overview
tasks.tactical_info: Effective methods of dispatching Factory Striders can be found on their page .
steps_zh: 消灭移动工厂：“轨道红外扫描已在该区域探测到一座移动工厂。——目标概述”
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 消灭移动工厂的有效方法可在其页面上找到。

tasks.name: Eliminate Automaton Hulks
steps:
Find Automaton Hulk
• The Hulk will need to be located within the Mission Objective radius. Once Helldivers locate Hulk, the Mission Objective marker will move directly onto it.
• The Hulk will always be the Obliterator variant, equipped with dual rocket launchers.

Eliminate Hulk
• Hellbombs can be called down by Helldivers once the Hulk has been located. Alternatively, Helldivers can use anti-armor weapons such as the GR-8 Recoilless Rifle or stratagems such as the Orbital Precision Strike .
tasks.tactical_info: Effective methods of dispatching Hulks can be found on their page .
steps_zh:
找到机器人巨型者
• 巨型者需要在任务目标半径内被定位。一旦绝地潜兵找到巨型者，任务目标标记会直接移到它身上。
• 巨型者总是湮灭者变体，装备双火箭发射器。

消灭巨型者
• 找到巨型者后，绝地潜兵可以呼叫地狱火炸弹。或者，绝地潜兵可以使用 GR-8 无后坐力炮等反装甲武器或轨道精准攻击等战略配备。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 消灭巨型者的有效方法可在其页面上找到。

tasks.name: Eliminate Devastators
steps: Eliminate Devastators [0/1] or [0/2]
tasks.tactical_info: Rocket Devastators and Heavy Devastators first appear on this mission; methods of dispatching them can be found on their respective pages. tasks.tactical_info_zh: 火箭蹂躏者和重型蹂躏者首次出现在本任务中；消灭它们的方法可在各自页面上找到。

tasks.name: Eradicate Automaton Forces
steps: Deploy down the mission area
Eliminate any/all enemy forces entering and/or inside the mission area
tasks.tactical_info: Eradication Missions are set up similarly to Tower Defenses , where Helldivers must "hold" the mission area and eliminate the incoming enemies. Due to the nature of this mission, Helldivers should equip armor, stratagems , and weapons that are effective at eliminating hordes of enemies. Using the RL-77 Airburst Rocket Launcher is highly recommended due to its massive area clearing capabilities, reloadable nature and can be used when other area clearing stratagems are not available. The best way to use it is to post up on an elevated ridge and shoot down at the hordes of bots and be sure to use the proper modes to avoid a premature detonation which will likely occur in operator and/or teammate death. Equipping Heavy Armor will increase the wearer's survivability, as the small mission area and high volume of enemies results in little room to maneuver and dodge enemy attacks. Since Automatons will be deployed from Dropships , equipping Support Weapons that can eliminate them (either destroying the engines, or the vehicle itself) is highly recommended. However, destroying Dropships will not count towards the kill count; it is only to relieve pressure and reduce the enemies inbound. If the Dropship has deployed its troops, though, its fall and explosion may cause its payload to be destroyed. Deploying Sentries are also beneficial during this mission since it can aid in eliminating enemies, as well as supporting Helldivers in their task. Special care should be taken in their placement to maximize their coverage, and prevent friendly fire. (either to fellow Helldivers, the sentry themselves, or nearby sentries in the line of fire)
steps_zh: 部署到任务区域
消灭进入和/或位于任务区域内的任何/所有敌方部队
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 歼灭任务与塔防类似，绝地潜兵必须“守住”任务区域并消灭来袭敌人。由于本任务的性质，绝地潜兵应装备擅长消灭成群敌人的护甲、战略配备和武器。强烈推荐使用 RL-77 空爆火箭弹发射器，因为它具有巨大的区域清理能力、可装填的特性，并且可以在其他区域清理战略配备不可用时使用。最佳用法是驻守在高处山脊上，向成群的机器人射击，并务必使用正确的模式以避免过早引爆（通常会导致操作者或队友死亡）。装备重甲会提高穿着者的生存能力，因为狭小的任务区域和大量的敌人几乎没有机动和躲避敌人攻击的空间。由于机器人会从运输舰部署，强烈建议装备能够消灭它们的支援武器（要么摧毁引擎，要么摧毁车辆本身）。然而，摧毁运输舰不计入击杀数；这只是为了减轻压力并减少来袭敌人。不过，如果运输舰已部署部队，其坠落和爆炸可能导致其载荷被摧毁。部署哨戒炮在本任务中也很有益，因为它可以协助消灭敌人并支援绝地潜兵。部署位置需特别小心，以最大化覆盖范围并防止友军误伤（无论是误伤队友、哨戒炮本身，还是火力线上的附近哨戒炮）。

tasks.name: Halt Cyborg Production
steps:
Adjust all the valves to maximize hydrogen flow
• There are 2 to 3 valves in each mission area
• Interact with each valve and rotate it until the pressure gauge needle hits the red zone
• Hydrogen pipes, when overloaded, will become hazards that set Helldivers on Fire
tasks.tactical_info: The Cooling Tower requires a demolition force of 50 to destroy, which means it can be destroyed through means other than a NUX-223 Hellbomb : A B-100 Portable Hellbomb . A Eagle 500kg Bomb . Orbital 120mm , Orbital 380mm , Orbital Precision Strike , Orbital Walking Barrage , Orbital Gas Strike , Orbital EMS Strike , or the Orbital Smoke Strike The last three requires a direct hit. The Cyborg Production tower produces an immensely large explosion 30 seconds after the final step to initiate destruction. It is recommended to begin running away as soon as the demolition process begins to survive the shockwave. Make sure the area is clear before entering the Cyborg Production Facility's doors to overload the hydrogen; there is only one way out, and it is easy to be surrounded.
steps_zh:
调整所有阀门以最大化氢气流量
• 每个任务区域有 2 到 3 个阀门
• 与每个阀门交互并旋转，直到压力表指针到达红色区域
• 氢气管道超载时会成为让绝地潜兵着火的危险源
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 冷却塔需要 50 的拆毁值才能摧毁，这意味着它可以通过 NUX-223 地狱火炸弹以外的方式摧毁：B-100 便携式地狱火炸弹、飞鹰 500kg 炸弹、轨道 120mm、轨道 380mm、轨道精准攻击、轨道游走火力网、轨道毒气攻击、轨道电磁冲击波攻击或轨道烟雾攻击。最后三种需要直接命中。生化人生产塔在启动摧毁的最后步骤 30 秒后会产生极其巨大的爆炸。建议一旦破坏过程开始就立即开始逃跑以在冲击波中幸存。在进入生化人生产设施的门口使氢气超载前，确保区域已清空；只有一条出路，很容易被包围。

tasks.name: Neutralize Ground-to-Orbit Defenses
steps:
Call down and defend a Hellbomb until it explodes to destroy the orbital cannon.
• Only Hellbombs , B-100 Portable Hellbombs and SEAF Artillery : Mini-Nuke shells can destroy the orbital cannons.
tasks.tactical_info: One configuration of the Orbital Cannon is defended by three ground-level Cannon Turrets . Several Automaton Fabricators also surround each Orbital Cannon. The outpost is moderately defended relative to the difficulty level with a mix of Troopers , Devastators , Hulks , and Scout Striders . In addition, all Orbital Cannons are surrounded with Automaton MG Emplacements . Helldivers should be advised of the burning pit below the bridge in one configuration of the Orbital Cannon, as it is an instant death to fall into it.
steps_zh:
呼叫并保护一枚地狱火炸弹，直到它爆炸摧毁轨道加农炮。
• 只有地狱火炸弹、B-100 便携式地狱火炸弹和 SEAF 火炮：迷你核弹炮弹才能摧毁轨道加农炮。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 轨道加农炮的一种配置由三门地面加农炮炮塔防御。每座轨道加农炮周围还有多台机器人制造机。前哨相对难度等级有中等程度的防御，混合了劫掠者、蹂躏者、巨型者和侦察纵步者。此外，所有轨道加农炮周围都环绕着机器人机枪部署支架。绝地潜兵应注意轨道加农炮某配置中桥梁下方的燃烧坑，掉进去会立即死亡。

tasks.name: Rapid Acquisition
steps:
Seize High-Grade Platinum
• Call down the Cargo Container stratagem.
• Load Platinum Bars into Cargo Container. (the number required is equal to 3 times the current difficulty level)
A Pelican ship will take away the Cargo Container when either the time runs out or it is full allowing Pelican 1 to land for extraction.
Reward: 500 Requisition Slips and 100 Experience
tasks.tactical_info: Large amounts of Automatons spawn on this mission, and the short time limit means Helldivers must balance their forces between holding back the horde and acquiring platinum bars. It is strongly recommended that Helldivers do not designate too many forces towards either carrying bars or covering fire, as neglecting either aspect of this mission easily leads to failure. Press the left mouse button / right trigger to throw the platinum bar forward a short distance, making transportation more convenient. It is recommended to bring crowd control stratagems like MD-8 Gas Mines and EMS Mortar Sentry to disorient enemies and cover the approach of platinum-carrying Helldivers. Eagle Smoke Strike also provides great soft cover for platinum-carrying Helldivers. Orbital Smoke Strike also works but covers less area and cannot be used as quickly.
steps_zh:
夺取高品位铂金
• 呼叫货物集装箱战略配备。
• 将铂条装入货物集装箱。（所需数量等于当前难度等级的 3 倍）
当时间耗尽或集装箱装满时，鹈鹕飞机会带走货物集装箱，使鹈鹕 1 号能够降落进行撤离。
奖励：500 申购点和 100 经验
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 本任务会生成大量机器人，而且时间限制很短，绝地潜兵必须在阻挡兽群和获取铂条之间平衡兵力。强烈建议绝地潜兵不要将太多兵力分配去搬运铂条或掩护射击，因为忽视本任务的任何一方面都容易导致失败。按鼠标左键/右扳机可将铂条向前抛出一小段距离，使运输更方便。建议携带 MD-8 毒气地雷和电磁冲击波迫击哨戒炮等群体控制战略配备，以迷惑敌人并掩护搬运铂金的绝地潜兵前进。飞鹰烟雾攻击也为搬运铂金的绝地潜兵提供了很好的软掩体。轨道烟雾攻击也有效，但覆盖面积更小且无法快速使用。

tasks.name: Sabotage Air Base
steps:
Destroy Air Base Control Tower [ edit | edit source ]
Standard Automaton Megafactory “ All Dropship communication is routed through this Control Tower. Destroying it will disable any long range dropship deployments. — Objective Overview “ This Control Tower is the nexus of enemy aerial operations in the region. — Megafactory objective Overview, Cyberstan mission Locate and unlock system access port Helldivers must find and interact with a SSSD container found inside the base Use Stratagem: SSSD Delivery Helldivers must call down the SSSD by inputting: Collect the SSSD Hard Drive Insert SSSD into receptacle The receptacle can either be found next to the terminal present in the air base, or next to the Air Base Control Tower itself. Hack into the terminal to sabotage Control Tower Helldivers must find and interact with the terminal found inside the base Bypass terminal security Helldivers are presented with a puzzle, requiring them to match Automaton letters into the correct order, shown by the key on the right side of the terminal. Use terminal to sabotage Control Tower Helldivers are required to activate three different switches, similar to a SEAF SAM Site Use terminal to complete sabotage Helldivers are required to press a single switch, doing so will start a 10 second countdown after which the Air Base Control Tower will explode and the objective will be completed. The explosion is similar to that of a NUX-223 Hellbomb , so Helldivers are advised to stay away from the Air Base Control Tower during the countdown sequence.

Destroy Dropships [ edit | edit source ]
Standard Automaton Megafactory “ An Automaton Air Base is located in this region. Dropships are undergoing maintenance at this facility, leaving them vulnerable. — Objective Overview “ Automaton Dropships are docked at this location. — Megafactory objective Overview, Cyberstan mission Destroy Automaton Dropships Helldivers are required to use any means necessary to destroy all Dropships present.
tasks.tactical_info: The Dropships in the "Destroy Dropships" objective are not the same as their flying counterparts as they have significantly less health at 1,000 vs 3,500, and the thrusters are not separate parts of the fuselage. Eagle stratagems such as the Eagle 500kg Bomb , Eagle Airstrike , and Eagle Strafing Run can destroy multiple dropships. Any Weapon/Stratagem with Anti-Tank I armor penetration, preferably with high durable damage such as the PLAS-45 Epoch or LAS-99 Quasar Cannon , can destroy the grounded Dropships. 1 shot with any Anti-Tank. 1 shot from the GP-20 Ultimatum or 2 from the P-33 Missile Pistol 1 G-123 Thermite or G-48 Giga Grenade , or 2 TM-1 Lure Mine 2 fully-charged shots with the PLAS-45 Epoch . 3-4 99% charged shots with the RS-422 Railgun . Conventional attacks cannot destroy the Air Base Control Tower. You must call down the objective equipment, insert it, and engage the terminal to self-destruct the tower.
steps_zh:
摧毁空军基地控制塔
标准机器人大型工厂
“所有运输舰通信都通过这座控制塔路由。摧毁它将禁用任何远程运输舰部署。——目标概述”
“这座控制塔是该区域敌方空中行动的枢纽。——大型工厂目标概述，塞伯斯坦任务”
定位并解锁系统访问端口：绝地潜兵必须找到并交互基地内发现的 SSSD 容器。
使用战略配备：SSSD 运输：绝地潜兵必须通过输入代码呼叫 SSSD。
拾取 SSSD 硬盘。
将 SSSD 插入接收槽：接收槽可以在空军基地内的终端旁找到，也可以在空军基地控制塔本身旁边找到。
入侵终端以破坏控制塔：绝地潜兵必须找到并交互基地内发现的终端。
绕过终端安全系统：绝地潜兵会看到一个谜题，需要将机器人字母按正确顺序匹配，由终端右侧的键指示。
使用终端破坏控制塔：绝地潜兵需要激活三个不同的开关，类似于 SEAF 防空导弹阵地。
使用终端完成破坏：绝地潜兵需要按一个开关，这将启动 10 秒倒计时，之后空军基地控制塔将爆炸，目标完成。爆炸类似于 NUX-223 地狱火炸弹，因此建议绝地潜兵在倒计时期间远离空军基地控制塔。

摧毁运输舰
标准机器人大型工厂
“该区域设有一个机器人空军基地。运输舰正在该设施进行维护，使其处于易受攻击状态。——目标概述”
“机器人运输舰停泊在此位置。——大型工厂目标概述，塞伯斯坦任务”
摧毁机器人运输舰：绝地潜兵必须使用任何必要手段摧毁在场的所有运输舰。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: “摧毁运输舰”目标中的运输舰与其飞行同类不同，它们的生命值显著更低（1,000 对比 3,500），且推进器不是机身的独立部件。飞鹰 500kg 炸弹、飞鹰空袭和飞鹰机枪扫射等飞鹰战略配备可以摧毁多艘运输舰。任何具有反坦克 I 护甲穿透的武器/战略配备，最好是高耐久伤害的，如 PLAS-45 纪元或 LAS-99 类星体加农炮，都可以摧毁停放的运输舰。任何反坦克武器 1 发。GP-20 最后通牒 1 发或 P-33 制导手枪 2 发。1 个 G-123 铝热弹或 G-48 千兆级榴弹，或 2 个 TM-1 诱饵地雷。PLAS-45 纪元 2 发全充能射击。RS-422 磁轨炮 3-4 发 99% 充能射击。常规攻击无法摧毁空军基地控制塔。你必须呼叫目标装备、插入并操作终端使塔自毁。

tasks.name: Sabotage Orgo-Plasma Synthesis
steps:
Destroy the bio-processors (up to 5 per objective)
• The Helldivers must destroy the specified number of bio-processors in order to complete the objective.
tasks.tactical_info: Bio-Processors are completely unarmored, so they are vulnerable to all Helldiver weaponry , including basic small arms fire. Can be destroyed in one shot from the GP-20 Ultimatum or a single TED-63 Dynamite . Direct Confrontation with the Outpost can be easily avoided if a Helldiver is able to throw a high-damaging Stratagem near the Bio-Processors, such as an Eagle 500kg Bomb . Similar to other Optional Objectives that require Helldivers to destroy a structure, a Hellbomb stratagem is provided to Helldivers when in close proximity to the Bio-Processors. While this method allows Helldivers to destroy the Bio-Processors without using any of their own munitions or Stratagems, it takes substantially longer to call in and arm it than if they used their own equipment. A Hellpod has enough Demolition Force to destroy a Bio-Processor, which can be achieved by throwing a Stratagem Ball in the gap between the two parts of a Bio-Processors.
steps_zh:
摧毁生物处理器（每个目标最多 5 个）
• 绝地潜兵必须摧毁指定数量的生物处理器才能完成任务。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 生物处理器完全没有护甲，因此容易受到所有绝地潜兵武器（包括基础轻武器火力）的伤害。GP-20 最后通牒一发或单个 TED-63 炸药即可摧毁。如果绝地潜兵能在生物处理器附近投掷高伤害战略配备（例如飞鹰 500kg 炸弹），则可以轻松避免与前哨的正面冲突。与其他需要绝地潜兵摧毁结构的可选目标类似，当绝地潜兵接近生物处理器时会提供地狱火炸弹战略配备。虽然这种方法允许绝地潜兵不使用自己的弹药或战略配备就摧毁生物处理器，但呼叫和武装它比使用自己的装备要长得多。一个地狱舱具有足够的拆毁值来摧毁生物处理器，只需在生物处理器的两半之间的空隙投掷战略配备球即可实现。

steps: [ edit | edit source ] Destroy Stockpiled Ammunition [ edit | edit source ] Standard Automaton Megafactory “ Our intel suggests that the Automatons are stockpiling ammunition in this location. — Objective Overview “ Intel indicates that the Automatons are stockpiling ammunition in this location. — Megafactory objective Overview, Cyberstan mission .mw-parser-output .inline-icon-container{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;white-space:nowrap;gap:0.25em;vertical-align:middle}.mw-parser-output .inline-icon-img-wrapper{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;line-height:0}.mw-parser-output .inline-icon-img-wrapper a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:100%}.mw-parser-output .inline-icon-img-wrapper img{height:100%!important;width:auto!important;object-fit:contain;display:inline-block}.mw-parser-output .inline-icon-text{line-height:normal;display:inline-block}.mw-parser-output .shadow-dark{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 0.6em rgba(0,0,0,0.8))}.mw-parser-output .shadow-light{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 0.6em rgba(255,255,255,0.8))}.mw-parser-output .shadow-glow{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 0.6em rgba(255,255,255,1))}.mw-parser-output .shadow-grow{transition:transform 0.2s ease-in-out,filter 0.2s ease-in-out;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 0em rgba(255,255,255,0))}.mw-parser-output .inline-icon-container:hover .inline-icon-img-wrapper.shadow-grow{transform:scale(1.15);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 0.6em rgba(255,255,255,0.8))} Destroy Fuel Reserves [ edit | edit source ] “ Satellite imagery confirms that the Automatons are operating a fuel depot in this area. — Objective Overview
tasks.tactical_info: Ammo stockpiles can explode, maintaining distance is recommended. This explosion may set off other stockpiles if they are close enough together Destruction is counted when the ammunition is ignited, not when it explodes The Fuel Reserves can only be destroyed with demolition force 60 such as by a Hellbomb , B-100 Portable Hellbomb or SEAF Artillery : Mini-Nuke. In the mission to liberate Cyberstan, for the parallel pattern of fuel depots, you can destroy them in one go by precisely deploying a Hellbomb between the two fuel depot containers; for the diagonal pattern, place it at the closest corner to achieve a one-time destruction (orbital smoke grenades can cover your action to ensure precise placement).
steps_zh:
摧毁囤积的弹药
标准机器人大型工厂
“我们的情报表明机器人正在此位置囤积弹药。——目标概述”
“情报表明机器人正在此位置囤积弹药。——大型工厂目标概述，塞伯斯坦任务”
摧毁燃料储备：“卫星图像确认机器人正在该区域运营一座燃料库。——目标概述”
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 弹药堆可以爆炸，建议保持距离。如果堆垛彼此足够接近，这次爆炸可能引爆其他堆垛。弹药被点燃时即算摧毁，而非爆炸时。燃料储备只能用 60 拆毁力摧毁，例如地狱火炸弹、B-100 便携式地狱火炸弹或 SEAF 火炮：迷你核弹。在解放塞伯斯坦的任务中，对于平行排列的燃料库，可以在两个燃料库容器之间精确部署一枚地狱火炸弹一次性摧毁；对于对角排列，将其放置在最接近的角落以实现一次性摧毁（轨道烟雾弹可以掩护你的行动以确保精确放置）。

tasks.name: Seize Industrial Complex
steps:
Locate and unlock system access port
• Helldivers must find and interact with a SSSD container found inside the Refinery
steps_zh:
定位并解锁系统访问端口
• 绝地潜兵必须找到并交互精炼厂内发现的 SSSD 容器。

tasks.name: Blitz: Destroy Illuminate Warp Gateways
tasks.name_zh: 闪电战：摧毁光能族跃迁门
steps:
Find and destroy any active Warp Gateways
• A random number of Illuminate Warp Gateways must be destroyed.
Reward: Before multipliers, between 375 and 1250 Requisition Slips , and between 75 and 250 Experience
tasks.tactical_info: Because the mission's premise is about locating and destroying Warp Gateways, it is recommended to bring equipment that is capable of destroying them: The G-123 Thermite is a good throwable for destroying the Warp Gateways because Helldivers do not have to wait for the center aperture to open. Similar performance can be achieved by Stratagems such as Eagle Strafing Run and Orbital Gatling Barrage . Anti-Tank Support Weapons such as the GR-8 Recoilless Rifle , FAF-14 Spear , and LAS-99 Quasar Cannon can destroy the Warp Gateways from a long distance, providing safety for the Helldivers.
steps_zh:
找到并摧毁任何活跃的跃迁门
• 必须摧毁随机数量的光能族跃迁门。
奖励：倍数之前，根据难度为 375 至 1250 申购点，以及 75 至 250 经验。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 由于本任务的前提是定位并摧毁跃迁门，建议携带能够摧毁它们的装备：G-123 铝热弹是摧毁跃迁门的好投掷物，因为绝地潜兵无需等待中心孔洞打开。飞鹰机枪扫射和轨道加特林攻击等战略配备也能达到类似效果。GR-8 无后坐力炮、FAF-14 飞矛和 LAS-99 类星体加农炮等反坦克支援武器可以从远距离摧毁跃迁门，为绝地潜兵提供安全。

tasks.name: Blitz: Destroy Illuminate Warp Ships
tasks.name_zh: 闪电战：摧毁光能族跃迁舰
steps:
Find and destroy any active Warp Ships
• A random number of Illuminate Warp Ships must be destroyed.
Reward: Before multipliers, between 375 and 1250 Requisition Slips , and between 75 and 250 Experience
tasks.tactical_info: Warp Ships have a protective shield around them, you can break the shield for a small window of time to throw an explosive into the open door Warp Ships may have Lightning Spires stationed around them; to destroy these towers it is recommended to bring an Explosive Weapon such as the GP-31 Grenade Pistol or CB-9 Exploding Crossbow The Lightning Spires and the conduit-torch towers are considered as structures which require demolition force for the destruction. This means weapons like PLAS-1 Scorcher won't be able to destroy these towers. All explosive weapons can one-shot grounded warp ships from the door if the shield has been taken down. An Orbital Gas Strike , Orbital Laser , Orbital Precision Strike , Orbital Railcannon Strike , Eagle 500kg Bomb , a hit or explosion from a 120mm / 380mm / Walking Barrage shot or SEAF Artillery will destroy the Warp Ship even if its shields are activated.
steps_zh:
找到并摧毁任何活跃的跃迁舰
• 必须摧毁随机数量的光能族跃迁舰。
奖励：倍数之前，根据难度为 375 至 1250 申购点，以及 75 至 250 经验。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 跃迁舰周围有防护罩，你可以短暂击破护罩的窗口期，将爆炸物扔进打开的门内。跃迁舰周围可能设有闪电尖塔；要摧毁这些塔，建议携带 GP-31 榴弹手枪或 CB-9 爆燃弩等爆炸武器。闪电尖塔和导管火把塔被视为需要拆毁力才能摧毁的结构。这意味着 PLAS-1 焦土等武器无法摧毁这些塔。所有爆炸武器都可以在护罩被击破后，从门口一发摧毁停放的跃迁舰。轨道毒气攻击、轨道激光炮、轨道精准攻击、轨道炮攻击、飞鹰 500kg 炸弹、120mm/380mm/游走火力网的一发命中或爆炸，或 SEAF 火炮，即使在护罩激活时也能摧毁跃迁舰。

tasks.name: Blitz: Suppress Toxic Pollination
steps: Eradicate Void Blossoms in the area (the required number depends on objective layout)
tasks.tactical_info: This article is a stub . You can help by expanding it . The Void Blossom's petals have Medium armor, whereas the corona has Very Light armor. Shooting the corona will instantly destroy the flower. The Void Blossoms are fragile and found in clusters, Helldivers are advised to bring Weapons and Stratagems that deal explosive damage, such as the CB-9 Exploding Crossbow , GL-21 Grenade Launcher , or the Eagle Airstrike . Destroying the flower releases a powder around it which reverses certain Helldiver controls. The powder lasts for a few seconds and Helldivers afflicted by it will have their screen distorted. The area of reverse effect is 5 Meters and lasts for 12 seconds. If a Helldiver destroyed the flower outside of the reverse effect's range or walked into the powder, they will be affected only with a distortion effect, slowed movement and the inability to sprint. Although the screen distortion effect disappears once Helldivers leave the area of effect, control reversal will persist for a few seconds. The inputs for moving left and right will be reversed, as will the inputs for moving the camera left or right, and the Helldiver will be unable to sprint. Thus diving rapidly to exit the area of effect is advised.
steps_zh: 消灭区域内的虚空花朵（所需数量取决于目标布局）
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 虚空花朵的花瓣具有中甲护甲，而花冠具有甚轻护甲。射击花冠会立即摧毁花朵。虚空花朵脆弱且成簇出现，建议绝地潜兵携带造成爆炸伤害的武器和战略配备，例如 CB-9 爆燃弩、GL-21 榴弹发射器或飞鹰空袭。摧毁花朵会释放其周围的粉末，使某些绝地潜兵的控制反转。粉末持续几秒，受影响的绝地潜兵屏幕会扭曲。反转效果区域为 5 米，持续 12 秒。如果绝地潜兵在反转效果范围外摧毁花朵或走入粉末，只会受到扭曲效果、移动减慢且无法冲刺的影响。虽然离开效果区域后屏幕扭曲效果会消失，但控制反转会持续几秒。左右移动的输入会反转，左右移动相机的输入也会反转，且绝地潜兵无法冲刺。因此建议迅速扑倒以脱离效果区域。

tasks.name: Destroy Gazer Spire
steps: Call down a NUX-223 Hellbomb to destroy the Gazer Spire.
tasks.tactical_info: The Gazer Spire requires a demolition force of 60 , which means it can only be destroyed with a NUX-223 Hellbomb , a B-100 Portable Hellbomb or SEAF Artillery Mini-Nuke shell. Due to the (relatively) short range of these devices, speed is of the utmost urgency in order to deploy them. After spotting a Helldiver within their ~250 meter range, the Gazer Spire begin to charge up to fire its laser. Evasive action is highly recommended to its lethal beam. Vehicles, especially Exosuits , are very susceptible to being destroyed from the beam's long range. Similar to the Gazer , the Gazer Spire's beam can easily be outmaneuvered on foot by walking to the side or taking cover. Despite the ability to evade it, it is highly recommended to not be in its Line of Sight when it fires. Warp Gateways are constructed around the Gazer Spire's structure, which will constantly spawn enemy units unless destroyed.
steps_zh: 呼叫一枚 NUX-223 地狱火炸弹摧毁凝视者尖塔。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 凝视者尖塔需要 60 的拆毁力，这意味着它只能用 NUX-223 地狱火炸弹、B-100 便携式地狱火炸弹或 SEAF 火炮迷你核弹炮弹摧毁。由于这些设备（相对）射程较短，部署它们时速度至关重要。在约 250 米范围内发现绝地潜兵后，凝视者尖塔会开始充能以发射激光。强烈建议对其致命光束采取规避动作。载具，尤其是外骨骼，很容易被其远程光束摧毁。与凝视者类似，凝视者尖塔的光束可以通过向侧面移动或寻找掩体轻松在步行时规避。尽管可以躲避它，但强烈建议在其发射时不要处于其视线内。跃迁门环绕着凝视者尖塔的结构建造，除非被摧毁，否则会持续生成敌方单位。

tasks.name: Destroy Harvesters
steps:
Go to objective on map.

Kill the Harvester found in the area.
steps_zh:
前往地图上的目标点。
• 目标的精确位置可能不明确，因此请搜索附近的敌方营地。（在地图上标记为红色）
击杀该区域的猎杀器。

tasks.name: Eradicate Illuminate Forces
steps:
Destroy the Illuminate
• Helldivers must kill x amount of Illuminate, the exact number of which depends on the difficulty .
tasks.tactical_info: Due to the nature of Eradication missions, heavy weapons and heavier armor are highly recommended, though this ultimately depends on a Helldiver's preference against Illuminate forces. Since Illuminate enemies rely more on shields than armor, bring Anti-Tank weaponry is not required, though this ultimately depends on a Helldiver's role in their squad, especially ones that specialize in taking down heavier enemies, such as Fleshmobs and Harvesters . Additional considerations should also be taken as to the types of subfactions present on that planet, as certain enemies will require different approaches to their doctrines. While it is possible to eliminate almost all Illuminate enemies with Very Light weaponry, it is recommended to equip a Primary and/or Secondary Weapon with an Light penetration or higher in order to reduce the stress of being overwhelmed by enemies when separated from your Support Weapon. Unlike other factions, the Illuminate depend more on mobility to overcome rather than pure firepower.
steps_zh:
摧毁光能族
• 绝地潜兵必须击杀 x 数量的光能族，确切数量取决于难度。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 由于歼灭任务的性质，强烈推荐重武器和较重护甲，尽管这最终取决于绝地潜兵对抗光能族部队的偏好。由于光能族敌人更依赖护盾而非护甲，携带反坦克武器并非必需，不过这最终取决于绝地潜兵在小队中的角色，尤其是专精消灭重型敌人的角色，例如肉瘤体和猎杀器。还应考虑该星球上存在的子阵营类型，因为某些敌人需要不同的应对策略。虽然几乎可以用甚轻武器消灭所有光能族敌人，但建议装备穿透等级为轻或更高的主武器和/或副武器，以减少在与支援武器分离时被敌人淹没的压力。与其他阵营不同，光能族更依赖机动性而非纯粹的火力来取胜。

tasks.name: Extract Anomalous Material
steps: Enter the GATER near the front left of the vehicle to complete this sub-objective.
tasks.tactical_info: The Ground All-Terrain Extraction Rig will self-destruct in a huge explosion after completing its task (akin to a Hellbomb ).
steps_zh: 进入车辆前左侧的 GATER 以完成此子目标。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 地面全地形提取装置（GATER）在完成任务后会以巨大的爆炸自毁（类似于地狱火炸弹）。

tasks.name: Free Colony
steps:
(If Helldivers are out of range) Move closer to objective
• Helldivers must move closer to the objective location.
Use Stratagem: SUPER EARTH FLAG

Flag Raising
• Helldivers must wait and defend the flag from constant Illuminate Reinforcements the entire one minute and forty seconds until the objective is complete.
• Unlike flag raising objectives on other fronts, Helldivers do not have to clear the area once the flag is fully raised.
steps_zh:
（如果绝地潜兵超出范围）靠近目标
• 绝地潜兵必须向目标位置靠近。
使用战略配备：超级地球旗帜

升旗中
• 绝地潜兵必须等待并防守旗帜，抵御持续的光能族增援，持续 1 分 40 秒直到目标完成。
• 与其他战线的升旗目标不同，旗帜完全升起后绝地潜兵无需清理区域。

tasks.name: Infiltrate Illuminate Lair
steps: Use Stratagem: AQUIFER DRILL
tasks.tactical_info: Due to the dynamic nature of the mission objectives, Helldivers should plan their loadout accordingly: One of the objectives requires the use of a Support Weapon slot, Backpack-only stratagems are preferred, and/or Expendable ones). Due to the oppressive firing range of the Gazer Spire , letting them stay active will make it tougher to complete other nearby objectives. It is highly reccomended that Helldivers destroy them first before starting other objectives. Condemn Illicit Experiments objective mechanics: Voteless growth pods and skull-like machinery in objective can be destroyed. It does not affect objective step; destroyed machinery must be recorded the same way. Unlike similar Commando objective , Helldivers are NOT required to extract with the Tactical Video Camera. It means that support weapon slot is used by mission equipment for a short time only. Portable Comms Relay is a medium-size boxy structure that stays permanently once summoned. Anything on the ground under it becomes inaccessible It will always drop at the same location as Tactical Video Camera, meaning that if a Helldiver dropped a support weapon when picking up the camera, that weapon will be effectively lost once Portable Comms Relay drops See Blitz mission for more details about Void Blossom flowers
steps_zh: 使用战略配备：含水层钻机
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 由于任务目标的动态特性，绝地潜兵应相应规划装备：其中一个目标需要使用支援武器槽位，优先选择仅背包的战略配备和/或一次性装备。由于凝视者尖塔的压制性射程，让它们保持活跃会使完成其他附近目标更困难。强烈建议绝地潜兵在开始其他目标前先摧毁它们。谴责非法实验目标机制：可以摧毁无票者生长舱和目标中的骷髅状机器。它不影响目标步骤；被摧毁的机器必须以相同方式记录。与类似的突击行动目标不同，绝地潜兵无需携带战术摄像机撤离。这意味着支援武器槽位仅短暂被任务装备占用。便携式通信中继站是一个中型盒状结构，召唤后永久存在。其下方的任何地面物品都会变得无法访问。它总是降落在与战术摄像机相同的位置，这意味着如果绝地潜兵在拾取摄像机时放下了支援武器，该武器将在便携式通信中继站降落后实际上丢失。关于虚空花朵的更多细节请参阅闪电战任务。

tasks.name: Repel Invasion Fleet

Prevent Super Earth's control of the area from hitting 0. Control starts to diminish when a high number of Illuminate ships are deployed.
steps_zh: 摧毁已着陆的跃迁舰，直到跃迁舰储备归零且每一艘已着陆的跃迁舰都被摧毁。
防止超级地球对该区域的控制降至 0。当大量光能族舰船部署时，控制会开始下降。

tasks.name: Retrieve Recon Craft Intel

Once the Black Box is taken to the uplink site, Helldivers must interact with the terminal and radio tower to complete the objective.
• Once the objective tracker reads "Uploading Data to Super Earth Mainframe", Helldivers are free to leave the site as no more inputs are required after this stage.
steps_zh:
黑匣子被带到上行链路地点后，绝地潜兵必须与终端和无线电塔交互以完成任务。
• 一旦目标追踪器显示“正在向超级地球主机上传数据”，绝地潜兵即可自由离开该地点，因为此阶段后无需更多输入。

tasks.name: Take Down Overship
steps:
Find the hard disk containing the Access Codes.
• Helldivers must go to the Priority Emergency Bunkers then figure out which door is the correct one by opening them and then retrieving the Access Codes from the shelves inside. It is distinguished by a gray-ish rectangular appearance with a purple circle, identical to the appearance of Access Codes in Launch ICBM missions. It emits a constant sound of static and morse code, getting louder the closer the Helldiver is to the Disk containing the Codes.
tasks.tactical_info: When the Illuminate Overship is shot, it will retaliate by summoning Warp Ships on the Helldivers . It currently has no other effect on ground assets. Aiming the barrel of the Planetary Defense Cannon at the closest Port hole of the Overship will 1-shot the target once the shields have been disabled, requiring 2 shots. This drastically reduces the time needed to destroy it. The Overship's Shield can regenerate if Helldivers take too long firing the Planetary Defense Cannon in-between shots. Additional shells may need to be fired in order to deactivate the shield again. Despite firing at the shields with the Planetary Defense Cannon to be the most straightforward, they can be damaged with conventional weaponry. While the shield is still intact, if 20 seconds pass without the shield taking damage, it will begin to regenerate at a rate of 500 health per second. Once the shield has fallen, it will reappear after 60 seconds and start to regenerate, assuming the Overship hasn't been destroyed by then.
steps_zh:
找到包含访问代码的硬盘
• 绝地潜兵必须前往优先紧急地堡，然后通过开门找出正确的门，并从内部的架子上取回访问代码。它以偏灰色的矩形外观并带有紫色圆圈为特征，与发射洲际弹道导弹任务中的访问代码外观相同。它会持续发出静电和摩斯电码的声音，距离包含代码的硬盘越近声音越大。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 当光能族统御舰被射击时，它会通过在绝地潜兵身上召唤跃迁舰进行报复。目前它对地面资产没有其他影响。将行星防御加农炮的炮管瞄准统御舰最近的一个舷窗，可以在护盾被禁用后 1 发命中目标，需要 2 发。这大大缩短了摧毁它所需的时间。如果绝地潜兵在发射行星防御加农炮之间花太长时间，统御舰的护盾可以再生。可能需要发射额外炮弹以再次停用护盾。尽管用行星防御加农炮射击护盾是最直接的方式，但它们也可以用常规武器造成伤害。当护盾完好时，如果 20 秒内护盾未受到伤害，它将开始以每秒 500 生命值的速度再生。一旦护盾落下，如果统御舰届时尚未被摧毁，它会在 60 秒后重新出现并开始再生。

tasks.name: Anti-Air Emplacement
steps:
Destroy Automaton Anti-Air Emplacements.
• Helldivers are permitted to call down a NUX-223 Hellbomb to destroy the AA-emplacements.
• Alternatively any Weapon with Medium penetration or above are able to destroy the vents of the emplacements while any Heavy penetrative weaponry or Stratagems can destroy the Anti-Air Emplacement to any part of the defense.
Reward: 200 Requisition Slips & 50 Experience .
tasks.tactical_info: When a Helldiver is within 150m of an Anti-Air Emplacement, all Eagles become unusable. Their call-in sequences will be replaced by a message reading "Obstructed by Anti-Air". Anti-Air Emplacements will shoot upwards periodically letting players looking into the distance identify the location of the Anti-Air Emplacement. The majority of the Anti-Air Emplacement is covered in Heavy armor, while having a Medium weakspot on the back, therefore any Heavy armor-penetrating weapon such as the AC-8 Autocannon and LAS-98 Laser Cannon can destroy them from range at any angle without having to call down a NUX-223 Hellbomb . Any anti-tank weapon can 1-shot the emplacements. The RS-422 Railgun requires an 80% charge shot to destroy. The PLAS-45 Epoch is a 1 shot with an uncharged shot. Weapons with Medium penetration can still kill a Anti-Air Emplacement from range however because they can only damage them from the back a helldiver will have to circle around to the correct position or wait for them to turn in a favorable direction. Oddly enough, AA Emplacements will rotate and "target" all Guard Dogs so stowing your Guard Dog by pressing the "Use Backpack Function" button ( PC default press 5 , PlayStation default press D-Pad Down ) is recommended to prevent aggro and make flanking the Emplacement easier. Weapons that only have Heavy penetration should also try to target the weakspots as they inflict their full damage on them leading to a far faster kill with less ammo expended. This is especially true for weapons that have shrapnel, as shrapnel has Medium penetration, often leading to a 1-shot. Anti-Air Emplacements can also be destroyed by any of the offensive Stratagems (excluding Eagles ), Emplacement Stratagems , as well as the MD-17 Anti-Tank Mines if using handheld weapons aren't a viable option or to save ammo. Damaging Grenades that have Heavy or above can destroy Anti-Air Emplacement. Thermite can 1-shot Anti-Air Emplacement if it sticks to it The G-12 High Explosive can also 1-shot Anti-Air Emplacement but requires them to detonate very close to the structure, typically by cooking the grenade and throwing it so it explodes in the air. The TED-63 Dynamite is more flexible due to higher explosion damage and larger blast radius so you only need to land the throwable in between two emplacements. Helldivers should be careful calling in an Eagle near the edge of the Anti-Air Emplacement. If Eagle 1 enters the AA's coverage she will be shot at and ALL eagles will be put on cooldown, as if the Eagle Rearm stratagem was used, while repairs to the craft are made. The crafts called in from the DSS Eagle Strike are unaffected and will perform Strafing Runs through the AA-Emplacements. If hit, the affected Eagle will immediately swerve up to safety to do more runs instead of having to leave.
steps_zh:
摧毁机器人防空阵地。
• 绝地潜兵可以呼叫 NUX-223 地狱火炸弹来摧毁防空阵地。
• 或者，任何中甲或以上穿透的武器都能摧毁阵地的排气口，而任何重甲穿透武器或战略配备都能摧毁防空阵地的任何防御部位。
奖励：200 申购点和 50 经验。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 当绝地潜兵距离防空阵地 150 米内时，所有飞鹰都变得不可用。它们的呼叫序列会被替换为“被防空火力阻挡”的信息。防空阵地会周期性向空中射击，让远眺的玩家能识别防空阵地的位置。防空阵地的大部分覆盖着重甲护甲，而背部有一个中甲弱点，因此任何重甲穿透武器（如 AC-8 机炮和 LAS-98 激光大炮）都能从任意角度的远距离摧毁它们，无需呼叫 NUX-223 地狱火炸弹。任何反坦克武器都能 1 发摧毁阵地。RS-422 磁轨炮需要 80% 充能射击才能摧毁。PLAS-45 纪元未充能射击即可 1 发摧毁。中甲穿透武器仍能从远距离击杀防空阵地，但由于它们只能从背部造成伤害，绝地潜兵必须绕到正确位置或等待它们转向有利方向。奇怪的是，防空阵地会旋转并“瞄准”所有护卫犬，因此建议按“使用背包功能”键（PC 默认按 5，PlayStation 默认按 D-Pad 下）收起护卫犬，以防止吸引仇恨并使包抄阵地更容易。只有重甲穿透的武器也应尝试瞄准弱点，因为对其造成全额伤害，能用更少弹药更快击杀。对有破片的武器尤其如此，因为破片有中甲穿透，往往导致 1 发击杀。防空阵地也可以被任何攻击型战略配备（飞鹰除外）、阵地战略配备以及 MD-17 反坦克地雷摧毁，如果手持武器不可行或想节省弹药。伤害型手榴弹中重甲或以上可以摧毁防空阵地。铝热弹如果粘上去可以 1 发摧毁防空阵地。G-12 高爆弹也可以 1 发摧毁防空阵地，但需要它们在非常靠近结构处引爆，通常是通过预热手榴弹并投掷使其在空中爆炸。TED-63 炸药更灵活，因为爆炸伤害更高、爆炸半径更大，只需将投掷物落在两个阵地之间。绝地潜兵在防空阵地边缘附近呼叫飞鹰时应小心。如果飞鹰 1 号进入防空覆盖范围，它会被射击，所有飞鹰都会进入冷却，就像使用了飞鹰重新装填战略配备一样，同时进行飞行器维修。从 DSS 飞鹰攻击呼叫的飞行器不受影响，会穿过防空阵地进行扫射。如果被击中，受影响的飞鹰会立即向上规避到安全高度以进行更多扫射，而不是被迫离开。

tasks.name: Cognitive Disruptor
steps:
Destroy Illuminate Cognitive Disruptor.
• Helldivers must destroy Cognitive Disruptor PSUs placed on nearby generators to disable it.
tasks.tactical_info: It's impossible to destroy the Cognitive Disruptor itself with any Support Weapon or Stratagem . Orbital Barrages can easily destroy the Cognitive Disruptor PSUs when thrown towards it. ex. Orbital Napalm Barrage , Orbital 120mm HE Barrage , and Orbital 380mm HE Barrage . The randomized codes caused by the Disruptor are not random in the sense that each individual arrow is randomized; rather, there is a list of sequences to draw from. This list not only includes other stratagem inputs, but also many humorous ones, such as a code comprised entirely of left inputs or even the infamous Konami Code .
steps_zh:
摧毁光能族认知干扰器。
• 绝地潜兵必须摧毁放置在附近发电机上的认知干扰器电源单元以将其禁用。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 用任何支援武器或战略配备都不可能摧毁认知干扰器本身。轨道火力网投向它时可以轻松摧毁认知干扰器电源单元。例如轨道凝固汽油弹火力网、轨道 120mm 高爆弹火力网和轨道 380mm 高爆弹火力网。干扰器造成的随机代码并非每个箭头都随机；相反，有一份可供抽取的序列列表。这份列表不仅包括其他战略配备输入，还包括许多幽默代码，例如完全由左输入组成的代码，甚至还有著名的科乐美代码。

tasks.name: Compromise Automaton Defenses
steps:
Locate and unlock system access port
• Helldivers must find and interact with a SSSD container found inside the outpost

Use Stratagem: SSSD Delivery
• Helldivers must call down the SSSD by inputting:
tasks.tactical_info: The outpost is typically heavily guarded by several Cannon Turrets on each side. Outposts on Megafactories also contain Anti-Air Emplacements that will disable the use of any Eagle Stratagems for Helldivers within 150m. When the objective is completed, all Cannon Turrets, Bunker Turrets , Mortar Emplacements , and Anti-Air Emplacements on the map will start to malfunction, visibly sparking and firing in random directions, unable to target Helldivers or deny Eagle deployments. Optional Objectives such as Mortar Emplacements will not be completed when compromised. Helldivers must still destroy them to gain completion rewards. Command Bunker turrets are also affected upon completion.
steps_zh:
定位并解锁系统访问端口
• 绝地潜兵必须找到并交互前哨内发现的 SSSD 容器。

使用战略配备：SSSD 运输
• 绝地潜兵必须通过输入代码呼叫 SSSD。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 前哨通常受到两侧多个加农炮炮塔的重兵把守。大型工厂上的前哨还包含防空阵地，会禁用 150 米内绝地潜兵的任何飞鹰战略配备。目标完成后，地图上所有加农炮炮塔、地堡炮塔、迫击炮阵地和防空阵地都会开始故障，明显冒出火花并向随机方向开火，无法瞄准绝地潜兵或阻止飞鹰部署。迫击炮阵地等可选目标在被削弱时不会完成。绝地潜兵仍必须摧毁它们才能获得完成奖励。指挥地堡炮塔在完成后也会受影响。

Use Seismic Probe Stratagem
