tasks.name: Destroy High-Value Target
steps: [ edit | edit source ] There are no objective steps. This Optional Objective only appears when it is completed and that happens when the High-Value Target is destroyed. This characteristic is unique to this objective.
tasks.tactical_info: Hive Lord [ edit | edit source ] The Hive Lord has the largest Main health pool in the game by a significant margin, at 150,000 . But all body parts are 0% durable, so it takes full standard damage from all sources. Due to its extremely large health pool and wide sweeping lethal attacks, it is advised that the entire squad either avoids the Hive Lord entirely or coordinates to take it down. The Hive Lord's body is completely encased in Tank I armor, with the exception being Tank II armor on the head and it's Light armored open mouth. Its body armor can be broken with sustained anti-tank fire, revealing the Light -armored flesh beneath. When a plate of armor is close to being destroyed, it will visibly show cracks and breaks. The inner flesh is completely immune to explosion damage, so explosive weapons like the MS-11 Solo Silo should be avoided. Most of the toughness of the Hive Lord's plate armor comes from its massive, non-decaying bleedout pool. It behaves as extra health, for a total of 50,000 effective health per section. Helldivers who wish to take down a Hive Lord should consider bringing as much Anti-Tank I firepower as possible in the form of Stratagems and Support Weapons . Eagle Strafing Run and Orbital Gatling Barrage are both highly effective against the Hive Lord, as they can damage multiple spinal armor plates due to the Hive Lord's massive size. The GR-8 Recoilless Rifle , FAF-14 Spear , and EAT-17 Expendable Anti-Tank allow for focusing on breaking armor plates between orbital and Eagle cooldowns. The EXO-45 Patriot Exosuit is one of the most effective tools against a Hive Lord. Its missile arm can help strip an armor plate with rockets, dealing up to a total of 17,500 damage to an armor plate, allowing its Gatling arm to quickly inflict massive damage upon the stripped section. With a full magazine, the chaingun can deal up to 121,500 damage in this manner. However, due to their limited mobility and large frames, Exosuits are vulnerable to the Hive Lord's large attacks. The Bastion is likewise effective against a Hive Lord due to its high HP pool, allowing it to withstand multiple bile attacks, and its large cannon and HMG ammo reserves can destroy a plate and deal enough damage to take out the Hive Lord with ease. However, the driver must maneuver the tank away from burrowing Hive Lords to prevent the Hive Lord from flipping the tank. The B-100 Portable Hellbomb can inflict an extreme amount of damage if Helldivers can position it correctly. The best time to use it is typically when the Hive Lord attempts to spew bile, as this attack does not hit at point-blank range and keeps it in place long enough for the Hellbomb's countdown to finish. Once the armor is broken, high DPS weapons can be used to shred its main health pool by firing into the exposed Light armored flesh. Weapons such as the AR-61 Tenderizer , M-105 Stalwart , MGX-42 Bullet Storm , and M-1000 Maxigun perform well at this. The LIFT-850 Jump Pack or LIFT-182 Warp Pack can be used to avoid the Hive Lord's attacks. Light armor and the Experimental Infusion booster further increase movement speed on foot, and combining these options together can improve odds of survival. The Hive Lord's movements will cause tremors in the ground that slow all nearby units. Close proximity should be avoided when considering the presence of other Terminids The Hive Lord is immune to all effects that would stun or confuse it, whilst still being prone to direct gas damage and ignition by fire. When engaging or withdrawing from the Hive Lord, Helldivers should maintain distance from one another. The size of the Hive Lord's attacks makes it dangerous for them to remain close to each other, as one strike could potentially kill all of them. Most of the damage dealt by the bile of a Hive Lord is explosive, so bringing armor with the Fortified passive can help save Helldivers from these attacks or even make their damage negligible.
steps_zh: 没有目标步骤。此可选目标只在完成时出现，即高价值目标被摧毁时。这是本目标独有的特性。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 霸王虫：霸王虫拥有游戏中最高的主体生命值池，达 150,000。但所有身体部位耐久度均为 0%，因此所有来源的伤害都会造成全额标准伤害。由于其极其庞大的生命值池和广泛横扫的致命攻击，建议整个小队要么完全避开霸王虫，要么协调将其击倒。霸王虫的身体完全覆盖着坦克 I 护甲，头部是坦克 II 护甲，以及它那轻甲的敞开嘴巴。其身体护甲可以用持续的反坦克火力击破，露出下面轻甲的血肉。当一块护甲板接近被摧毁时，会明显出现裂纹和破损。内部血肉完全免疫爆炸伤害，因此应避免使用 MS-11 单兵导弹发射井等爆炸武器。霸王虫板甲的大部分韧性来自其庞大、不衰减的流血池。它充当额外生命值，每个部位总计 50,000 有效生命值。希望击倒霸王虫的绝地潜兵应考虑以战略配备和支援武器的形式携带尽可能多的反坦克 I 火力。飞鹰机枪扫射和轨道加特林攻击对霸王虫都非常有效，因为霸王虫体型巨大，可以伤害多块脊椎护甲板。GR-8 无后坐力炮、FAF-14 飞矛和 EAT-17 一次性反坦克火箭可以在轨道和飞鹰冷却之间专注于击破护甲板。EXO-45 爱国者外骨骼是对抗霸王虫最有效的工具之一。其导弹臂可以用火箭帮助剥离护甲板，对护甲板造成总计高达 17,500 点伤害，使其加特林臂能快速对剥离的部分造成巨大伤害。满弹匣时，加特林机枪可以这种方式造成高达 121,500 点伤害。然而，由于机动性有限和体型庞大，外骨骼容易受到霸王虫大型攻击的伤害。堡垒坦克对霸王虫同样有效，因为它生命值高，能承受多次胆汁攻击，其大型加农炮和重机枪弹药储备可以摧毁一块护甲板并造成足够伤害轻松击杀霸王虫。但驾驶员必须机动坦克远离钻地的霸王虫，以防止霸王虫掀翻坦克。B-100 便携式地狱火炸弹如果绝地潜兵能正确放置，可以造成极端伤害。使用它的最佳时机通常是霸王虫试图喷吐胆汁时，因为这种攻击不会在极近距离命中，并能让它保持位置足够长的时间让地狱火炸弹的倒计时完成。护甲被击破后，高 DPS 武器可以通过射击暴露的轻甲血肉来撕裂其主体生命值池。AR-61 肉锤、M-105 盟友、MGX-42 子弹风暴和 M-1000 重装机枪等武器表现良好。LIFT-850 喷射背包或 LIFT-182 传送背包可以用来躲避霸王虫的攻击。轻甲和实验灌注增益器进一步提高步行移动速度，结合这些选项可以提高生存几率。霸王虫的移动会引起地面震动，减缓附近所有单位。在考虑其他终结族存在时，应避免过于接近。霸王虫对所有使其眩晕或困惑的效果免疫，但仍容易受到直接毒气伤害和火焰点燃。与霸王虫交战时或撤退时，绝地潜兵应彼此保持距离。霸王虫攻击的规模使其彼此靠近很危险，因为一次打击可能杀死所有人。霸王虫胆汁造成的大部分伤害是爆炸性的，因此携带强化被动技能的护甲可以帮助绝地潜兵免受这些攻击或使其伤害可忽略不计。

tasks.name: Destroy Rogue Research Station
steps:
Destroy all facility buildings: 0/1
• The NUX-223 Hellbomb will be available to call down when near the research station.
Reward: 200 Requisition Slips and 50 Experience
tasks.tactical_info: Because the research station requires a Demolition of 50 to destroy, the Hellbomb is not strictly necessary for completion. The Eagle 500kg Bomb and most Orbital Strikes can be used to complete the objective faster. SEAF Artillery shells can also be used, though the Napalm, Smoke and Static shells will require a direct hit.
steps_zh:
摧毁所有设施建筑：0/1
• 靠近研究站时，NUX-223 地狱火炸弹将可呼叫。
奖励：200 申购点和 50 经验
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 由于研究站需要 50 拆毁值才能摧毁，地狱火炸弹并非严格必要。飞鹰 500kg 炸弹和大多数轨道攻击可以更快地完成任务。SEAF 火炮炮弹也可使用，不过凝固汽油弹、烟雾和静电炮弹需要直接命中。

tasks.name: Destroy Transmission Network
steps: Destroy Antenna Transmitters
tasks.tactical_info: Transmitters plates can be individually destroyed with small arms fire. Explosive weapons such as the CB-9 Exploding Crossbow , R-36 Eruptor or AC-8 Autocannon are most effective for destroying multiple transmitters in a single shot. Optionally the whole tower itself can be destroyed with explosive demolition force, such as the LAS-99 Quasar Cannon . This will also destroy the transmitters itself.
steps_zh: 摧毁天线发射器
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 发射器面板可以用轻武器火力单独摧毁。CB-9 爆燃弩、R-36 爆裂铳或 AC-8 机炮等爆炸武器对单发摧毁多个发射器最为有效。可选地，整个塔本身可以用爆炸性拆毁力摧毁，例如 LAS-99 类星体加农炮。这也会一并摧毁发射器。

tasks.name: Detector Tower
steps:
Destroy Automaton Detector Tower
• The NUX-223 Hellbomb will be available to call down when near the tower.
Rewards: 200 Requisition Slips , 50 Experience
tasks.tactical_info: The Detector Tower has a 150-meter range in which it can detect Helldivers, within its distinctive red vision cone. The position of the vision cone means that Helldivers that are very close to the Detector Tower cannot be spotted. Going prone will render Helldivers completely invisible to the Detector Tower. If a Helldiver is spotted, the tower will sound an audible alarm and begin summoning constant waves of bot drops until it can no longer see any Helldivers. Dropships spawned in this manner will deploy their units on the last known position of the Helldiver. The Demolition requirement of 50 means that a Hellbomb is unnecessary if alternate options are available. Common examples include the Eagle 500kg Bomb , Orbital Precision Strike and SEAF Artillery shells. Clever positioning can trick Cannon Turrets into destroying the Detector Tower with their shots. The Hellbomb's large AOE means that it can be called down far away from the Detector Tower (where one is at little risk of being spotted) and still complete the objective. Detector Towers will occasionally spawn inside of Fortresses . They function identically to standard Detector Towers, but the Hellbomb will not be available to call down to destroy them. They are also not mandatory to destroy to mark the Fortress as "cleared".
steps_zh:
摧毁机器人侦测塔
• 靠近塔时，NUX-223 地狱火炸弹将可呼叫。
奖励：200 申购点、50 经验
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 侦测塔有一个 150 米的探测范围，在其独特的红色视野锥内可以发现绝地潜兵。视野锥的位置意味着非常靠近侦测塔的绝地潜兵无法被发现。卧倒会使绝地潜兵对侦测塔完全隐形。如果绝地潜兵被发现，塔会发出可听见的警报，并开始召唤持续的机器人空投波次，直到它再也看不到任何绝地潜兵。以此方式生成的运输舰会在绝地潜兵最后已知位置部署单位。50 的拆毁要求意味着如果有替代选项，地狱火炸弹并非必需。常见例子包括飞鹰 500kg 炸弹、轨道精准攻击和 SEAF 火炮炮弹。巧妙的站位可以诱使加农炮炮塔用射击摧毁侦测塔。地狱火炸弹的大范围意味着可以远离侦测塔呼叫（在那里被发现的风险很小），仍能完成任务。侦测塔偶尔会在要塞内生成。它们与标准侦测塔功能相同，但地狱火炸弹将不可用。摧毁它们也并非将要塞标记为“已清除”的必要条件。

tasks.name: Eliminate Overseers
steps:
Eliminate Overseers
• The targeted amount of Overseers changes depending on the Difficulty
tasks.tactical_info: The Optional Objective will be active right away when the mission starts, and counts all Overseer kills made by all players. Weapons that deal area-of-effect damage are highly effective against Overseers, able to bypass both their deployable shield and the full-body suit of armor they wear. Overseers cover the weakest part of their body - the head - with an armored helmet. High damage armor-penetrating weapons can destroy their head in a single shot. Examples include the P-4 Senator , APW-1 Anti-Materiel Rifle , and RS-422 Railgun . The Overseer's shield is not large enough to cover its legs, allowing Helldivers to continue dealing damage to it while the shield is active.
steps_zh:
消灭监察者
• 目标的监察者数量随难度变化
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 此可选目标在任务开始时立即激活，并计算所有玩家击杀的所有监察者。造成范围伤害的武器对监察者非常有效，能够绕过他们的可部署护盾和全身护甲服。监察者用带护甲的头盔覆盖他们身体最脆弱的部分——头部。高伤害穿甲武器可以一发摧毁他们的头部。例子包括 P-4 参议员、APW-1 反器材步枪和 RS-422 磁轨炮。监察者的护盾不够大，无法覆盖腿部，使绝地潜兵在护盾激活时仍能继续对其造成伤害。

tasks.name: Enemy Bio-Processors
steps:
Destroy Bio-Processors
• Helldivers must destroy the Bio-Processors by any means necessary.
tasks.tactical_info: As the Bio-Processors are completely unarmored, they are vulnerable to all Helldiver weaponry , including basic small arms fire. Confrontation with the Automaton Outpost can be easily avoided if a Helldiver is able to throw either high-damaging or demo force 40 Stratagems near the Bio-Processors, such as an Eagle Airstrike . Similarly to other Optional Objectives that require Helldivers to destroy a structure, a Hellbomb stratagem is provided to Helldivers when in close proximity to the Bio-Processors. While this method allows Helldivers to destroy the Bio-Processors without using any of their own munitions or Stratagems, it takes substantially longer to call in and arm the Hellbomb than if a Helldiver were to use other means of destruction. The layout of some bases can cause Bio-Processors to be sufficiently far away from each other that a single Hellbomb cannot destroy them all, and cannot guarantee that the Orbital 120mm HE Barrage or Orbital 380mm HE Barrage will get them all. However the Orbital Laser will destroy them instantly and will track across the location to clear the objective, making it an effective solution if thrown close enough. 2 G-123 Thermite grenades will destroy a Bio-Processor, but only if they are thrown from close enough for the entire burn duration to apply to the structure, as the explosion only deals 2000 damage but can deal up to 2975 with the burn damage included. Some demolition force 40 or higher options to destroy the bio-processors are as follows: Hellpod impacts are demolition force 40, which can destroy Bio-Processors, which is easy to achieve by throwing a Stratagem Ball (of something that comes in a Hellpod) in the gap between the two parts of a Bio-Processor, such as the provided Hellbomb Stratagem. Bio-Processors can also be destroyed with a single charge from the B/MD C4 Pack , one shot from the EAT-411 Leveller or GP-20 Ultimatum , or a single TED-63 Dynamite / G-48 Giga Grenade .
steps_zh:
摧毁生物处理器
• 绝地潜兵必须用任何必要手段摧毁生物处理器。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 由于生物处理器完全没有护甲，它们容易受到所有绝地潜兵武器（包括基础轻武器火力）的伤害。如果绝地潜兵能在生物处理器附近投掷高伤害或 40 拆毁力的战略配备（例如飞鹰空袭），则可以轻松避免与机器人前哨的正面冲突。与其他需要绝地潜兵摧毁结构的可选目标类似，当绝地潜兵接近生物处理器时会提供地狱火炸弹战略配备。虽然这种方法允许绝地潜兵不使用自己的弹药或战略配备就摧毁生物处理器，但呼叫和武装地狱火炸弹的时间比使用其他破坏手段要长得多。一些基地的布局可能导致生物处理器彼此距离足够远，单枚地狱火炸弹无法全部摧毁，也无法保证轨道 120mm 高爆弹火力网或轨道 380mm 高爆弹火力网能全部命中。然而轨道激光炮会立即摧毁它们并追踪整个位置来清理目标，如果投掷得足够近，是个有效解决方案。2 个 G-123 铝热弹可以摧毁一个生物处理器，但前提是投掷得足够近，让整个燃烧时长作用于结构，因为爆炸只造成 2000 伤害，但计入燃烧伤害最高可达 2975。一些拆毁力 40 或更高的摧毁生物处理器的选项如下：地狱舱撞击的拆毁力为 40，可以摧毁生物处理器，只需在生物处理器的两半之间的空隙投掷战略配备球（用于任何乘地狱舱降落的东西，例如提供的地狱火炸弹战略配备）即可轻松实现。生物处理器也可以用 B/MD C4 背包的单个炸药、EAT-411 荡平者或 GP-20 最后通牒一发，或单个 TED-63 炸药/G-48 千兆级榴弹摧毁。

tasks.name: Erase Terrorist Memorials
steps: Destroy the statues within the Megafactory
tasks.tactical_info: The statues that need to be destroyed require a demolition force of 30 to destroy. List of weapons that can destroy them: Primary Weapons - R-36 Eruptor and CB-9 Exploding Crossbow Secondary Weapons - GP-20 Ultimatum and GP-31 Grenade Pistol Throwables - G-4 Gas , G-6 Frag , G-7 Pineapple , G-10 Incendiary , , G-12 High Explosive , G-13 Incendiary Impact , G-16 Impact , G-123 Thermite , TED-63 Dynamite , and TM-1 Lure Mine (when shot) Support Weapons - AC-8 Autocannon (APHET Mode), CQC-20 Breaching Hammer , EAT-17 Expendable Anti-Tank , EAT-411 Leveller , EAT-700 Expendable Napalm , GL-21 Grenade Launcher , GL-28 Belt-Fed Grenade Launcher , GR-8 Recoilless Rifle , LAS-99 Quasar Cannon , MLS-4X Commando , MS-11 Solo Silo , PLAS-45 Epoch (Fully-Charged), and S-11 Speargun
steps_zh: 摧毁大型工厂内的雕像
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 需要摧毁的雕像需要 30 拆毁力才能摧毁。能摧毁它们的武器列表：主武器 - R-36 爆裂铳和 CB-9 爆燃弩。副武器 - GP-20 最后通牒和 GP-31 榴弹手枪。投掷物 - G-4 毒气榴弹、G-6 破片榴弹、G-7 菠萝、G-10 燃烧弹、G-12 高爆弹、G-13 燃烧冲击弹、G-16 冲击弹、G-123 铝热弹、TED-63 炸药和 TM-1 诱饵地雷（射击时）。支援武器 - AC-8 机炮（APHET 模式）、CQC-20 破门锤、EAT-17 一次性反坦克火箭、EAT-411 荡平者、EAT-700 一次性凝固汽油弹、GL-21 榴弹发射器、GL-28 弹链式榴弹发射器、GR-8 无后坐力炮、LAS-99 类星体加农炮、MLS-4X 突击兵、MS-11 单兵导弹发射井、PLAS-45 纪元（全充能）和 S-11 矛枪。

tasks.name: Extract Anomalous Material
steps: Enter the GATER near the front left of the vehicle to complete this sub-objective.
tasks.tactical_info: The Ground All-Terrain Extraction Rig will self-destruct in a huge explosion after completing its task (akin to a Hellbomb ).
steps_zh: 进入车辆前左侧的 GATER 以完成此子目标。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 地面全地形提取装置（GATER）在完成任务后会以巨大的爆炸自毁（类似于地狱火炸弹）。

tasks.name: Gunship Facility
steps:
Find and destroy any active Automaton Gunship Fabricators
• Helldivers must approach the site, call down, arm and defend the Hellbomb until the structure is destroyed.
Reward: 200 Requisition Slips & 50 Experience
tasks.tactical_info: As long as a Helldiver remains within 150-meter radius, each operational Gunship Facility tower spawns up to two Gunships every 60-seconds up to a maximum of four active Gunships per tower. The Gunship Facility requires a demolition force of 60 to be destroyed. All Eagle and Orbital stratagems are ineffective and will not damage nor destroy Gunship Facilities. SEAF Artillery: Mini Nuke , B-100 Portable Hellbomb or NUX-223 Hellbomb can be used to destroy it. Note that the Gunship Facility MUST be within the 17 meter inner explosion radius to maximize demolition force as it falls-off in the outer radius. With careful positioning, it is possible to destroy dual Gunship Facility sites with a singular Hellbomb as long as they are both within the 17 meter radius.
steps_zh:
找到并摧毁任何活跃的机器人炮舰制造机
• 绝地潜兵必须接近现场，呼叫、武装并保护地狱火炸弹，直到结构被摧毁。
奖励：200 申购点和 50 经验
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 只要绝地潜兵留在 150 米半径内，每座运转的炮舰设施塔每 60 秒会生成最多两艘炮舰，每座塔最多四艘活跃炮舰。炮舰设施需要 60 拆毁力才能摧毁。所有飞鹰和轨道战略配备都无效，无法伤害或摧毁炮舰设施。SEAF 火炮：迷你核弹、B-100 便携式地狱火炸弹或 NUX-223 地狱火炸弹可用于摧毁它。请注意，炮舰设施必须在 17 米内圈爆炸半径内，以最大化拆毁力，因为它在内圈外会衰减。通过谨慎定位，只要双炮舰设施点都在 17 米半径内，可以用单枚地狱火炸弹摧毁它们。

tasks.name: Intercept Convoy
steps:
Locate the Automaton Convoy as it makes its way across the map
• Helldivers must approach the convoy and eliminate all 5 Factory Striders / Vox Engines.
Reward: 200 Requisition Slips & 50 Experience
tasks.tactical_info: In the normal variant of the mission, the convoy consists of 5 Factory Striders: 4 with Cannon Turrets and 1 with a Stratagem Scrambler (functionally identical to Cognitive Disruptor masqueraded as a downsized Stratagem Jammer ). The Jammer is Unarmored , 5,000 health, and 0% durable, so it can be destroyed by any weapon, although preferably with high damage weapons such as anti-tank. The Striders in a convoy, unlike normal Striders, can call in reinforcements when attacked, launching several bot flares into the air from one of the striders' rear. The reinforcement called in will be dropped ON the diver who triggered the reinforcement. It is advisable to assign one diver to lure the reinforcement drop so the rest of the team can deal with the striders without interruption. In the Cyborg variant of the mission, the Factory Striders will be replaced by 5 Vox Engines, all of which are normal Vox Engines without special capabilities. The Vox Engine version can be more easily dealt with, since it does not seem to have a capability to engage beyond ~150m and cannot call in any reinforcement upon being struck, meaning it is significantly easier to deal with them from a distance with long ranged anti-tank firepower such as the MS-11 Solo Silo or E/AT-12 Anti-Tank Emplacement . The convoy will not stop when engaged and will continue on its path to leave the map. It is advised to treat this secondary objective with high priority, being one of the very first ones that your squad should complete during the mission. The convoy completes its path in ~700 seconds, or 11 minutes and 40 seconds if the convoy is left untouched. The objective fails as soon as the first Factory Strider crosses the mission area border. The Vox Engine variant of the convoy, due to its slightly faster moving speed, completes its path in ~600 seconds, or around 10 minutes. The convoy is hesitant to turn too much from their intended path, so approaching from behind is a relatively safer option if you're close to the Factory Striders. The same tactics for fighting Factory Striders apply to this secondary objective, accounting for fighting five of them at once, along with the stratagem scrambler. Therefore, Anti-Tank stratagems such as the E/AT-12 Anti-Tank Emplacement (ATE), Orbital Laser and Orbital 380mm HE Barrage or Support Weapons such as the B/MD C4 Pack , EAT-411 Leveller , GR-8 Recoilless Rifle and MS-11 Solo Silo are recommended. When positioned far away with a good, elevated line of sight, the ATE is one of the most efficient and safe ways to take down a convoy, having more than enough shells to destroy all 5 if aiming for their faces. Place the ATE ahead of the convoy at an approximate 100-150m distance diagonal to their path to make it easier to see their face and 2 shot the exposed part of the head. It is recommended to destroy the top cannons first, removing the convoy's primary method of long-range return fire. A well-placed MS-11 Solo Silo can instantly destroy at least 2 of the Factory Striders , greatly expediting completion of the objective. The MD-17 Anti-Tank Mines are also a viable choice, having enough explosive power to kill or severely wound a Factory Strider in 2-3 mines. The convoy follows a very predictable path, so simply place the mines along it to augment your firepower.
steps_zh:
定位正在地图上行进的机器人车队
• 绝地潜兵必须接近车队并消灭全部 5 座移动工厂/噪轰引擎。
奖励：200 申购点和 50 经验
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 在任务的普通变体中，车队由 5 座移动工厂组成：4 座带加农炮炮塔，1 座带战略配备扰乱器（功能上与认知干扰器相同，伪装成缩小版的战略配备干扰器）。干扰器无护甲，5,000 生命值，0% 耐久度，因此可以被任何武器摧毁，不过最好用反坦克等高伤害武器。车队中的移动工厂与普通不同，受到攻击时可以呼叫增援，从其中一座工厂的后部向空中发射几发机器人信号弹。呼叫的增援会空投在触发增援的绝地潜兵身上。建议指定一名绝地潜兵引诱增援空投，以便其余队友不受干扰地处理移动工厂。在生化人变体中，移动工厂会被 5 台噪轰引擎取代，全部是没有特殊能力的普通噪轰引擎。噪轰引擎版本更容易对付，因为它似乎没有能力在约 150 米外交战，并且被击中时无法呼叫任何增援，这意味着用 MS-11 单兵导弹发射井或反坦克炮台等远程反坦克火力从远处对付它们要容易得多。车队被交战时不会停止，会继续沿路径驶离地图。建议将此次要目标视为高优先级，成为小队在任务中应最早完成的目标之一。车队完成路径约需 700 秒，即 11 分 40 秒（如果车队不受打扰）。只要第一座移动工厂越过任务区域边界，目标就会失败。车队的噪轰引擎变体由于移动速度稍快，约 600 秒或 10 分钟完成路径。车队不太愿意偏离预定路径太多，因此如果你靠近移动工厂，从后方接近是相对更安全的选择。对抗移动工厂的相同战术适用于此次要目标，同时要考虑同时对抗五座以及战略配备扰乱器。因此，建议使用 E/AT-12 反坦克炮台（ATE）、轨道激光炮和轨道 380mm 高爆弹火力网等反坦克战略配备，或 B/MD C4 背包、EAT-411 荡平者、GR-8 无后坐力炮和 MS-11 单兵导弹发射井等支援武器。当远距离定位并有良好的高视线时，ATE 是摧毁车队最有效和安全的方式之一，有足够多的炮弹瞄准其正面摧毁全部 5 座。将 ATE 放置在车队前方与其路径对角约 100-150 米处，更容易看到其正面并对暴露的头部部位 2 发命中。建议先摧毁顶部加农炮，消除车队主要的远程还击手段。放置得当的 MS-11 单兵导弹发射井可以立即摧毁至少 2 座移动工厂，大大加快任务完成。MD-17 反坦克地雷也是可行选择，2-3 枚地雷的爆炸力足以杀死或重伤一座移动工厂。车队沿非常可预测的路径行进，只需沿线放置地雷即可增强你的火力。

tasks.name: Launch ICBM
steps:
Find the hard disk containing the Launch Codes.
• Helldivers must go to the Human Structure (3 variations; Excavation, Junkyard, ) and find the Launch Codes. It is a blue-ish, big rectangle. It emits a constant sound of static and morse code, getting louder the closer the Helldiver is to the Disk containing the Codes.
steps_zh:
找到包含发射代码的硬盘
• 绝地潜兵必须前往人类建筑（3 种变体：挖掘场、废料场等）并找到发射代码。它是一个偏蓝色的大矩形，会持续发出静电和摩斯电码的声音，距离包含代码的硬盘越近声音越大。

tasks.name: Mobile Radar
steps:
Activate button
• Button activation causes the Mobile Radar to rotate, and the antenna updating the map after one second.
Reward: 200 Requisition Slips , 50 Experience
tasks.tactical_info: The Mobile Radar are hidden inside caves until it is physically spotted, or discovered by reaching it. Since it can reveal valuable map information, locating the station early on is highly recommended. Due to the dense and winding cave systems, being able to identify where Stalker Lairs are located is valuable in quickly neutralizing them.
steps_zh:
激活按钮
• 按钮激活会使移动雷达旋转，天线在一秒后更新地图。
奖励：200 申购点、50 经验
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 移动雷达隐藏在洞穴内，直到被物理发现或被到达时发现。由于它能揭示宝贵的地图信息，尽早定位该站点是强烈推荐的。由于洞穴系统密集蜿蜒，能够识别追踪虫巢穴的位置对快速消灭它们很有价值。

tasks.name: Mortar Emplacement
steps:
Destroy Automaton Mortar Emplacement.
• Helldivers are permitted to call down a NUX-223 Hellbomb to destroy the Mortar Emplacements.
• Alternatively any Weapon with Medium penetration or above are able to destroy the vents of the emplacements while any Heavy penetrative weaponry or Stratagems can destroy the Mortar Emplacement to any part of the defense.
Reward: 200 Requisition Slips & 50 Experience .
tasks.tactical_info: The Mortar Emplacement will only fire at enemy targets if they have been spotted by other automatons Additionally a Mortar Emplacement will only fire on those within 150m but can't see targets closer than 20m. When a Mortar Emplacement is firing at you, Mission Control will warn you with a voiceline: "Warning: you are in range of enemy artillery!" The mortar shells comes with bright red trails when traveling in the air. Players can look to the sky to determine the direction and location of the Mortar Emplacement. The majority of the mortar emplacement is covered in Heavy armor, while having Medium weakspots on the back, therefore any Heavy armor-penetrating weapon such as the AC-8 Autocannon and LAS-98 Laser Cannon can destroy them from range at any angle without having to call down a NUX-223 Hellbomb . Any anti-tank weapon can 1-shot the emplacements. The RS-422 Railgun requires an 80% charge shot to destroy. The PLAS-45 Epoch requires a fully-charged shot. Weapons with Medium penetration can still kill a Mortar Emplacement from range. However, because this can only damage them from the back, the Helldiver will have to circle around to the correct position. This is most easily performed when the Mortar Emplacement is shooting at a teammate, as every emplacement will be facing in the same direction without turning erratically. Weapons that only have Heavy penetration should also try to target the weakspots as they inflict their full damage on them leading to a far quicker kill with less ammo expended. This is especially true for weapons that have shrapnel, as shrapnel has Medium penetration, often leading to a 1-shot. Damaging Grenades that have Heavy or above can destroy Mortar Emplacement. Thermite can 1-shot Mortar Emplacement if it sticks to it Both G-12 High Explosive and TED-63 Dynamite can also 1-shot Mortar Emplacement but requires them to detonate very close to the structure, typically by cooking the grenade and throwing it so it explodes in the air. Mortar Emplacements can also be destroyed by any of the offensive Stratagems , Emplacement Stratagems , as well as the MD-17 Anti-Tank Mines if using handheld weapons aren't a viable option or to save ammo.
steps_zh:
摧毁机器人迫击炮阵地。
• 绝地潜兵可以呼叫 NUX-223 地狱火炸弹来摧毁迫击炮阵地。
• 或者，任何中甲或以上穿透的武器都能摧毁阵地的排气口，而任何重甲穿透武器或战略配备都能摧毁迫击炮阵地的任何防御部位。
奖励：200 申购点和 50 经验。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 迫击炮阵地只会在敌方目标被其他机器人发现后向其开火。此外，迫击炮阵地只会射击 150 米内的目标，但无法看到 20 米内的目标。当迫击炮阵地向你开火时，任务控制会用语音警告你：“警告：你处于敌方火炮射程内！”迫击炮弹在空中飞行时会带有明亮的红色尾迹。玩家可以仰望天空判断迫击炮阵地的方向和位置。迫击炮阵地的大部分覆盖着重甲护甲，背部有中甲弱点，因此任何重甲穿透武器（如 AC-8 机炮和 LAS-98 激光大炮）都能从任意角度的远距离摧毁它们，无需呼叫 NUX-223 地狱火炸弹。任何反坦克武器都能 1 发摧毁阵地。RS-422 磁轨炮需要 80% 充能射击才能摧毁。PLAS-45 纪元需要全充能射击。中甲穿透武器仍能从远距离击杀迫击炮阵地。然而，由于这只能从背部造成伤害，绝地潜兵必须绕到正确位置。当迫击炮阵地正在向队友射击时最容易做到这一点，因为每个阵地都会朝向同一方向且不会胡乱转向。只有重甲穿透的武器也应尝试瞄准弱点，因为对其造成全额伤害，能用更少弹药更快击杀。对有破片的武器尤其如此，因为破片有中甲穿透，往往导致 1 发击杀。伤害型手榴弹中重甲或以上可以摧毁迫击炮阵地。铝热弹如果粘上去可以 1 发摧毁迫击炮阵地。G-12 高爆弹和 TED-63 炸药也都可以 1 发摧毁迫击炮阵地，但需要它们在非常靠近结构处引爆，通常是通过预热手榴弹并投掷使其在空中爆炸。迫击炮阵地也可以被任何攻击型战略配备、阵地战略配备以及 MD-17 反坦克地雷摧毁，如果手持武器不可行或想节省弹药。

tasks.name: Purge Hatcheries
steps: [ edit | edit source ] Destroy Eggs [ edit | edit source ] “ Large quantities of eggs are located in this area. Use any means necessary to destroy them. — Mission Briefing
tasks.tactical_info: The Eggs are fragile, numerous, and found in clusters. Helldivers are advised to bring Weapons and Stratagems that deal explosive damage, such as the CB-9 Exploding Crossbow , R-36 Eruptor , GL-21 Grenade Launcher , AC-8 Autocannon or the Eagle Airstrike . A single B-100 Portable Hellbomb or Eagle 500kg Bomb can destroy all the eggs in the nest. Since the Eggs can't take much damage before being destroyed, the FLAM-40 Flamethrower is an efficient choice. While Helldivers are able to destroy eggs with bare-handed melee damage, the bursting eggs create a shockwave sending a Helldiver into fatal impact-damage. Fortunately even short-range melee-weapons such as CQC-5 Combat Hatchet and CQC-30 Stun Baton have long enough reach to dispose eggs without the risk of being expulsed.
steps_zh: 摧毁卵：“该区域存放着大量卵。使用任何必要手段摧毁它们。——任务简报”
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 这些卵脆弱、数量众多且成簇出现。建议绝地潜兵携带造成爆炸伤害的武器和战略配备，例如 CB-9 爆燃弩、R-36 爆裂铳、GL-21 榴弹发射器、AC-8 机炮或飞鹰空袭。单枚 B-100 便携式地狱火炸弹或飞鹰 500kg 炸弹即可摧毁巢内所有卵。由于卵在摧毁前无法承受太多伤害，FLAM-40 火焰喷射器是个高效选择。虽然绝地潜兵能用徒手近战伤害摧毁卵，但爆裂的卵会产生冲击波，将绝地潜兵推向致命的撞击伤害。幸运的是，即使是 CQC-5 战斗斧和 CQC-30 眩晕警棍等短程近战武器也有足够的攻击距离，可以在不被弹飞的风险下处理卵。

tasks.name: Radar Station
steps:
Activate Terminal
• Pressing the interact button on the terminal powers it on, then Helldivers must confirm the prompt "Raise Radar Tower?" by interacting with the terminal and pressing the up button. After 35 seconds, the Radar Tower has been raised.

Align Radar Tower
• Helldivers must now spin the Radar Dish at the Radar Tower, until it has been aligned with the direction shown on the terminal. Then, Helldivers must interact with the terminal and confirm the activation by pressing the up button.
Reward: 200 Requisition , 50 Experience
tasks.tactical_info: The Radar Station remains hidden on the map until it is either spotted (pinged) by a Helldiver or physically discovered by reaching its location. Due to the valuable information it reveals, locating the station early in the mission should be a priority. The Dish's correct orientation will always be towards the closest point that is on the outer perimeter of the map. If the dish is close to the west side of the map it should point west, and so forth. Searching for the Radar Station can be simplified by scanning the horizon for its distinctive structure or by checking the map for the typical surrounding topography. Attentive Helldivers can also memorize the location of all hotzones shown during mission "Briefing" to narrow down location of undiscovered secondary objectives due this hotzone not being highlighted on the mission minimap. Topographics will confirm whether or not the secondary objective is a Radar Station or something else. Some mission objectives (such as Retrieve Valuable Data ) feature a similar-looking antenna. In these cases, pinging the antenna will reveal its purpose. Communication is key for a quick and easy completion of the Radar Station objective: It is advised to check the correct alignment on the terminal before turning the antenna. During alignment, the antenna emits a distinctive beep when correctly aligned. This allows the Helldiver to identify the correct alignment without needing to see the terminal or rely on instructions from another player. Helldivers can ping the terminal to call out the correct orientation, without depending on voice comms. Using voice comms generally makes communication easier. Helldivers may use degrees, compass directions, or clock positions to indicate the correct orientation to teammates. Often, simple cues like "left" or "the other left" are more effective, as teammates may not know which reference is used. It is advised to place a sentry nearby to automatically defend against incoming threats during the alignment process.
steps_zh:
激活终端
• 按下终端上的交互按钮为其通电，然后绝地潜兵必须通过交互终端并按下上方向按钮确认“升起雷达塔？”的提示。35 秒后，雷达塔已升起。

对齐雷达塔
• 绝地潜兵现在必须旋转雷达塔上的雷达天线盘，直到它与终端上显示的方向对齐。然后，绝地潜兵必须与终端交互并通过按下上方向按钮确认激活。
奖励：200 申购点、50 经验
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 雷达站保持在地图上隐藏，直到被绝地潜兵发现（标记）或通过到达其位置物理发现。由于它能揭示宝贵的信息，在任务早期定位该站应是优先事项。天线盘的正确朝向总是朝向地图外围最近的边界点。如果天线盘靠近地图西侧，它应指向西，以此类推。搜索雷达站可以通过扫描地平线寻找其独特结构或查看地图寻找典型的地形特征来简化。细心的绝地潜兵也可以记住任务“简报”中显示的所有热点区域的位置，以缩小未发现次要目标的位置范围，因为这些热点不会在任务小地图上高亮。地形将确认次要目标是否是雷达站还是其他东西。某些任务目标（如取回宝贵数据）具有类似的天线。在这种情况下，标记天线将揭示其用途。快速轻松完成雷达站目标的关键是沟通：建议在旋转天线前检查终端上的正确对齐方向。对齐期间，当天线正确对齐时会发出独特的蜂鸣声。这使绝地潜兵无需查看终端或依赖其他玩家的指示就能识别正确的对齐方向。绝地潜兵可以标记终端来呼叫正确的朝向，而无需依赖语音通信。使用语音通信通常使沟通更容易。绝地潜兵可以使用度数、指南针方向或时钟位置向队友指示正确的朝向。通常，简单的提示如“左边”或“另一个左边”更有效，因为队友可能不知道使用的是哪个参考系。建议在附近放置一个哨戒炮，在对齐过程中自动防御来袭威胁。

tasks.name: Raze Strategic Infrastructure
steps:
Destroy buildings within the Megafactory
• Requires at least ____ to complete the sub-objective
tasks.tactical_info: The buildings that need to be demolished for the sub-objective require a demolition force of 40 , which limits the type of weaponry capable of destroying them. These include large-scale buildings, rather than smaller infrastructure such as chimneys. (which cannot be destroyed) List of weaponry capable of destroying them: Helldiver Weapons/Throwables - GP-20 Ultimatum , G-48 Giga Grenade and TED-63 Dynamite Support Weapons - B/MD C4 Pack , B-100 Portable Hellbomb , EAT-411 Leveller , and MS-11 Solo Silo . Eagle Stratagems - 500kg Bomb , Eagle Airstrike , and Eagle Smoke Strike . Orbital Stratagems - all Orbital Strategems except Orbital Airburst Strike , Orbital Gatling Barrage and Orbital Napalm Barrage . Due to the buildings being relatively spread out throughout the map, it is recommended to destroy nearby buildings whenever possible. In order to maximize Orbital Stratagem usage, it is recommended to aim them near intact buildings whenever possible. Orbital Stratagems do require Super Destroyer line-of-sight, so it may need to reposition in order to begin bombardment.
steps_zh:
摧毁大型工厂内的建筑
• 至少需要 ____ 来完成子目标
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 需要为子目标拆除的建筑需要 40 拆毁力，这限制了能够摧毁它们的武器类型。这些是大型建筑，而非烟囱等较小基础设施（无法摧毁）。能摧毁它们的武器列表：绝地潜兵武器/投掷物 - GP-20 最后通牒、G-48 千兆级榴弹和 TED-63 炸药。支援武器 - B/MD C4 背包、B-100 便携式地狱火炸弹、EAT-411 荡平者和 MS-11 单兵导弹发射井。飞鹰战略配备 - 500kg 炸弹、飞鹰空袭和飞鹰烟雾攻击。轨道战略配备 - 除轨道空爆攻击、轨道加特林攻击和轨道凝固汽油弹火力网外的所有轨道战略配备。由于建筑在地图上相对分散，建议尽可能摧毁附近的建筑。为了最大化轨道战略配备的使用，建议尽可能瞄准附近完好的建筑。轨道战略配备确实需要超级驱逐舰的视线，因此可能需要重新定位以开始轰炸。

tasks.name: Recover Scientific Specimen
steps:
Collect Specimen Case
• Like an SSSD, Helldivers will carry the Specimen Case with one hand, restricting them to One-Handed weapons.
(If the Specimen Case is dropped) Recover the Dropped Specimen Case
Extract With Specimen Vessel
tasks.tactical_info: The Specimen Vessel can be found by viewing the map. The specific location of the Specimen Vessel is obscured, similar to the Poor Intel mission modifier. The Specimen Vessel will be guarded by several Terminids as well as a few Bug Holes .
steps_zh:
拾取样本箱
• 像 SSSD 一样，绝地潜兵将单手携带样本箱，限制为仅限单手武器。
（如果样本箱掉落）找回掉落的样本箱
携带样本容器撤离
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 样本容器可以通过查看地图找到。样本容器的具体位置是模糊的，类似于情报不足任务修正。样本容器将受到几个终结族以及几个虫洞的守卫。

tasks.name: Recover SSSD
steps:
Collect SSSD
• Like an SSSD found in other missions, Helldivers will carry the SSSD with one hand, restricting them to One-Handed weapons.
(If the SSSD is dropped) Recover the Dropped SSSD
Extract With SSSD
tasks.tactical_info: The SSSD can be found by viewing the map. The specific location of the SSSD is obscured, similar to the Poor Intel mission modifier. The SSSD will be guarded by several Terminids as well as a few Bug Holes .
steps_zh:
拾取 SSSD
• 像其他任务中的 SSSD 一样，绝地潜兵将单手携带 SSSD，限制为仅限单手武器。
（如果 SSSD 掉落）找回掉落的 SSSD
携带 SSSD 撤离
tasks.tactical_info_zh: SSSD 可以通过查看地图找到。SSSD 的具体位置是模糊的，类似于情报不足任务修正。SSSD 将受到几个终结族以及几个虫洞的守卫。

tasks.name: Reinforcement Pods
steps:
Establish connection to Super Destroyer to secure reinforcements.
• Entering the stratagem code will start to establish the link. After 10 seconds, the link will be completed, granting 3 additional reinforcements.
Reward: 200 Requisition Slips , 50 Experience , 3 Reinforcements
tasks.tactical_info: When Reinforcement Pods have been successfully connected to the destroyer, their glowing ring will change from a blinking yellow to a solid green. When a Helldiver dies and is reinforced, they will deploy from the group of pods nearest to whoever called the reinforcements.
steps_zh:
建立与超级驱逐舰的连接以获取增援。
• 输入战略配备代码将开始建立连接。10 秒后，连接完成，获得 3 次额外增援。
奖励：200 申购点、50 经验、3 次增援
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 当增援舱成功连接到驱逐舰时，其发光环会从闪烁的黄色变为稳定的绿色。当绝地潜兵死亡并被增援时，他们将从最靠近呼叫增援者的那组增援舱中部署。

tasks.name: Retrieve Mutant Larva
steps: Collect Specimen Vessel *
(If the Specimen Vessel is dropped) Recover the Dropped Specimen Vessel
Extract With Specimen Vessel
tasks.tactical_info: The Specimen Vessel can be found on the map. Terminids around it will defend the vessel. Bug Holes , if presented within the vicinity of the Speciemen Vessel will produce bugs at a slightly faster rate than they usually do. Terminids are attracted to Helldivers carrying the Vessel; make sure to protect them.
steps_zh: 拾取样本容器 *
（如果样本容器掉落）找回掉落的样本容器
携带样本容器撤离
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 样本容器可以在地图上找到。周围的终结族会保卫容器。如果样本容器附近有虫洞，它们会以比平时稍快的速度产生虫族。终结族会被携带容器的绝地潜兵吸引；请确保保护他们。

tasks.name: SEAF Artillery
steps: Activate Artillery Terminal

Find artillery shells and load them into artillery gun
• Up to seven shells will be scattered around the objective. Five of them must be loaded by hand.
• Shells are two-handed objects, so Helldivers cannot sprint or hold a weapon while carrying them.
• Each shell has a different effect when the SEAF Artillery stratagem is used.

Use terminal to establish communication with Super Destroyer
• Directional inputs must be used to raise the signal strength to 100%.

Wait for the artillery system to initiate
• This step will complete on its own, so any Helldivers present are free to leave.

Rewards: 200 Requisition Slips , 50 Experience , SEAF Artillery stratagem
• Using the stratagem will prompt the artillery platform to fire a shell at the beacon.
tasks.tactical_info: During mission planning, the SEAF Artillery stratagem is listed as standard issue if an artillery site is present on the map. The shells will be fired in the order of when they were loaded each time the stratagem is used. Communicating the order of the shells to other teammates by voice/text chat is recommended. Unlike orbital strikes , the angle at which the shell will impact is independent of the Super Destroyer's position, being perfectly vertical instead. All artillery shells have a minimum Demolition of 50, allowing them to destroy most structures. Smoke, Static Field and Napalm shells will require direct hits. Mini-Nuke shells can destroy objectives that usually mandate a Hellbomb , such as the Gunship Facility and Automaton Orbital Cannon . The SEAF Artillery cannot be disabled by a Stratagem Jammer or Ion Storms , and remains available when mission time runs out. Combined with the shells' demolition force, an active jammer can be neutralized safely instead of having to assault it directly. SEAF Artillery shells can be thrown great distances by utilizing a special technique: First, standing in front of a shell in the direction you want the shell to be thrown. Then, interact with the shell to pick it up and open the map before it reaches your hands. Finally, sprint to close the map to grab the thrown shell. Contrary to some belief, activating the artillery terminal will not alert nearby enemies, it is simply coincidence due to patrol routes.
steps_zh: 激活火炮终端

找到炮弹并将其装入火炮
• 最多七枚炮弹将散布在目标周围。其中五枚必须手动装载。
• 炮弹是双手物品，因此绝地潜兵在携带时无法冲刺或持有武器。
• 每枚炮弹在使用 SEAF 火炮战略配备时有不同效果。

使用终端建立与超级驱逐舰的通信
• 必须使用方向输入将信号强度提升至 100%。

等待火炮系统启动
• 此步骤会自动完成，因此在场的任何绝地潜兵都可以自由离开。

奖励：200 申购点、50 经验、SEAF 火炮战略配备
• 使用该战略配备将促使火炮平台向信标发射一枚炮弹。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 在任务规划期间，如果地图上存在火炮阵地，SEAF 火炮战略配备会被列为标准配备。炮弹将按装入的顺序每次使用该战略配备时发射。建议通过语音/文字聊天将炮弹的顺序告知队友。与轨道攻击不同，炮弹撞击的角度与超级驱逐舰的位置无关，而是完全垂直的。所有炮弹的最低拆毁力为 50，使它们能摧毁大多数结构。烟雾、静电场和凝固汽油弹炮弹需要直接命中。迷你核弹炮弹可以摧毁通常需要地狱火炸弹的目标，例如炮舰设施和机器人轨道加农炮。SEAF 火炮不会被战略配备干扰器或离子风暴禁用，并在任务时间耗尽时仍然可用。结合炮弹的拆毁力，可以安全地消除活跃的干扰器，而无需直接攻击它。SEAF 火炮炮弹可以利用特殊技巧投掷很远的距离：首先，站在炮弹前方，朝向你想投掷的方向。然后，与炮弹交互以拾起它，并在它到达你手中之前打开地图。最后，冲刺以关闭地图，接住投掷出的炮弹。与某些人的看法相反，激活火炮终端不会惊动附近的敌人，这只是巡逻路线的巧合。

tasks.name: SEAF SAM Site
steps: Activate terminal

Use terminal to raise surface-to-air launcher
• A six-input long code must be inputted.
• After this step, Helldivers must wait for the SAM launcher to fully raise.

Use terminal to activate surface-to-air launcher sub-systems
• Each subsystem must be activated individually.

Rewards: 200 Requisition Slips , 50 Experience , SAM launcher aerial denial
• The launcher carries twenty-four missiles, and will deactivate upon expending them all.
tasks.tactical_info: SAM sites will target the following enemies: Dropship , Gunship , Stingray , Warp Ship , Leviathan The SAM site will only target one enemy at a time, and multiple sites will not coordinate with each other. This may result in two launchers firing at the same enemy, wasting their shots. The SAM site's high damage allows it to fully destroy a Dropship's fuselage, instantly killing all of its occupants. The Warp Ship's shield can allow it to nullify a single missile. Helldivers may wish to break the shield manually first to ensure the SAM site destroys the Warp Ship. The missile has a relatively low velocity, and as such may miss faster aerial units. Notably, SAM sites may fail to destroy Dropships before they unload their occupants. The SAM site generates significant backblast when firing. Helldivers are advised to not stand behind the launcher when it is activated, as the backblast is powerful enough to kill lightly armored Helldivers. The SAM Site can be destroyed causing the objective to fail, though the cause is unknown.
steps_zh: 激活终端

使用终端升起地对空发射器
• 必须输入六位长代码。
• 此步骤后，绝地潜兵必须等待 SAM 发射器完全升起。

使用终端激活地对空发射器子系统
• 每个子系统必须单独激活。

奖励：200 申购点、50 经验、SAM 发射器防空封锁
• 发射器携带二十四枚导弹，全部耗尽后停用。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: SAM 阵地会瞄准以下敌人：运输舰、炮舰、刺魟、跃迁舰、利维坦。SAM 阵地一次只能瞄准一个敌人，多个阵地不会相互协调。这可能导致两座发射器向同一敌人开火，浪费弹药。SAM 阵地的高伤害使其能完全摧毁运输舰的机身，立即杀死所有乘员。跃迁舰的护盾可以使其抵消单枚导弹。绝地潜兵可能希望先手动击破护盾，以确保 SAM 阵地摧毁跃迁舰。导弹速度相对较低，因此可能错过较快的空中单位。值得注意的是，SAM 阵地可能无法在运输舰卸载乘员前将其摧毁。SAM 阵地发射时会产生显著的后爆。建议绝地潜兵在发射器激活时不要站在其后方，因为后爆威力足以杀死轻甲绝地潜兵。SAM 阵地可以被摧毁导致目标失败，原因未知。

tasks.name: Secondary Extraction Zone
steps: Destroy enemy deployment structures to secure the area.
tasks.tactical_info: Due to the way terrain generates for each map, the Secondary Extraction Zone may be in an inconvienent spot if the original extraction zone is close to the final objective(s). As such, Helldivers should plan their routes accordingly if the Secondary Extraction Zone is more convienent. Aside from possible convienince, the Secondary Extraction Zone does not provide any combat benefits from clearing it. Despite this, clearing them out is highly recommended in order to reduce extraction complications, such as overwhelming patrols.
steps_zh: 摧毁敌方部署结构以保卫该区域。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 由于每个地图的地形生成方式，如果原撤离点靠近最终目标，备用撤离区可能位于不便的位置。因此，如果备用撤离区更方便，绝地潜兵应相应规划路线。除了可能的便利外，清理备用撤离区不提供任何战斗增益。尽管如此，强烈建议清理它们以减少撤离时的复杂情况，例如压倒性的巡逻队。

tasks.name: Shrieker Nest
steps: Destroy Shrieker Nest
Reward: 200 & 50
tasks.tactical_info: The structure has Light Armor and can be destroyed by most Weapon or Stratagem . However, its 100% durable narrows the amount of effective primary weaponry to destroy it quickly and with less ammo usage. Shriekers will only spawn if there are Helldivers within 130 meters of the nest detected by the enemy. Helldivers may know the distance of a point by pinging it. Laser weapons such as LAS-5 Scythe or LAS-7 Dagger are capable to easily dispatch Shriekers when getting close to a Shrieker Nest, as the hitscan nature of these weapons makes them ideal for consistently hitting and igniting agile fliers. It is advised to look up before calling a NUX-223 Hellbomb since Hellpod might stuck due to mushroom-like nature of nest and waste the opportunity to quickly complete the objective. While not recommended, a three landed hellpods is enough to destoy one tower. Due to the dangerous nature of this structure, using a NUX-223 Hellbomb to destroy it is not recommended. Instead, engage it from outside of the Shrieker spawning range with weapons such as FAF-14 Spear , GR-8 Recoilless Rifle or AC-8 Autocannon with FLAK rounds. Vehicles such as EXO-49 Emancipator Exosuit or TD-220 Bastion are very effective against several Shrieker Nests in a single use. A few shield bashes from EXO-55 Breakthrough Exosuit is enough to destoy one tower without consuming his flak cannon ammo. One E/MG-101 HMG Emplacement has enough ammo to deal with 3 towers with ammo to spare. The MGX-42 Bullet Storm can destroy a single tower at the cost of nearly its full magazine. The weapon's easily replaceable nature makes this strategy viable (if lengthy), but it's best used to finish off a tower that's already been damaged. A single EAT-17 and a few seconds of Bullet Storm fire will destroy a single tower, freeing the second EAT-17 from the same Hellpod to be used on a second tower.
steps_zh: 摧毁尖啸虫巢穴
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 该结构有轻甲护甲，可以被大多数武器或战略配备摧毁。然而，其 100% 的耐久度缩小了能快速并以较少弹药摧毁它的有效主武器范围。尖啸虫只会在有绝地潜兵被敌人发现并在巢穴 130 米范围内时生成。绝地潜兵可以通过标记一个点知道其距离。激光武器如 LAS-5 长柄镰或 LAS-7 匕首在接近尖啸虫巢穴时能轻松消灭尖啸虫，因为这些武器的即时命中特性使其非常适合持续命中并点燃敏捷的飞行单位。建议在呼叫 NUX-223 地狱火炸弹前先向上看，因为地狱舱可能因巢穴的蘑菇状特性而卡住，浪费快速完成任务的机会。虽然不推荐，但三个着陆的地狱舱足以摧毁一座塔。由于该结构的危险性，不建议使用 NUX-223 地狱火炸弹来摧毁它。相反，在尖啸虫生成范围外使用 FAF-14 飞矛、GR-8 无后坐力炮或 AC-8 机炮（使用破片弹）等武器交战。EXO-49 解放者外骨骼或 TD-220 堡垒等载具对单次使用摧毁多个尖啸虫巢穴非常有效。EXO-55 突破外骨骼的几次盾击足以摧毁一座塔，而不消耗其破片加农炮弹药。一座 E/MG-101 重机枪部署支架有足够弹药处理 3 座塔还有余量。MGX-42 子弹风暴可以以几乎整匣弹药的代价摧毁单座塔。该武器易于更换的特性使此策略可行（尽管耗时），但最好用于摧毁已受损的塔。单发 EAT-17 加上几秒的子弹风暴火力将摧毁一座塔，释放同一地狱舱中的第二发 EAT-17 用于第二座塔。

tasks.name: Spore Spewer
steps: Destroy Terminid Spore Spewer
Reward: 200 & 50
tasks.tactical_info: The structure has Light Armor. It can be destroyed by any Weapon or Stratagem. However, it is 100% durable, which causes primary weaponry to take a very long time to destroy it. Offensive stratagems such as the Orbital Precision Strike , Eagle Strafing Run , Eagle 500kg Bomb , Eagle Airstrike , and the Orbital Railcannon Strike (which will target the structure) will destroy it instantly. 3-4 shots from the R-36 Eruptor . 1 shot from the GP-20 Ultimatum . 1 shot from the EAT-411 Leveller , FAF-14 Spear , GR-8 Recoilless Rifle , MS-11 Solo Silo & TD-220 Bastion MK XVI or 2 from the EAT-17 Expendable Anti-Tank , E/AT-12 Anti-Tank Emplacement , LAS-99 Quasar Cannon , and MLS-4X Commando . 12-13 shots from Heavy armor penetrating weapons such as the APW-1 Anti-Materiel Rifle , 75 shots from the MG-206 Heavy Machine Gun , and 3-4 shots from the AC-8 Autocannon when using FLAK. The Helldiver cannot rely on pinging this structure to alert their teammates, as it will not say anything and the marker will display "Enemy Unit" instead of a custom voiceline specific to this structure.
steps_zh: 摧毁终结族孢子喷射者
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 该结构有轻甲护甲。它可以用任何武器或战略配备摧毁。然而，它 100% 耐久，导致主武器需要很长时间才能摧毁。轨道精准攻击、飞鹰机枪扫射、飞鹰 500kg 炸弹、飞鹰空袭和轨道炮攻击（会瞄准该结构）等攻击型战略配备会立即摧毁它。R-36 爆裂铳 3-4 发。GP-20 最后通牒 1 发。EAT-411 荡平者、FAF-14 飞矛、GR-8 无后坐力炮、MS-11 单兵导弹发射井和 TD-220 堡垒 MK-XVI 1 发，或 EAT-17 一次性反坦克火箭、反坦克炮台、LAS-99 类星体加农炮和 MLS-4X 突击兵 2 发。APW-1 反器材步枪等重甲穿透武器 12-13 发，MG-206 重机枪 75 发，AC-8 机炮使用破片弹时 3-4 发。绝地潜兵无法依靠标记此结构来提醒队友，因为它不会说任何话，且标记会显示“敌方单位”而非针对此结构的自定义语音。

tasks.name: Spread Democracy
steps:
(If no Helldiver is within the 25-meter range) Move closer to objective
• Helldivers must move closer to the objective location.
Use Stratagem: SUPER EARTH FLAG

Flag Raising
• Helldivers must wait and defend the flag from constant Bug Breaches/Bot Drops the entire one minute and forty seconds until the objective is complete.
• Enemies near the objective must be all killed once the flag has fully raised to complete the objective.
• Should all Helldivers leave the area of the flag before the objective is completed, the flag's progress will begin reversing.
steps_zh:
（如果没有绝地潜兵在 25 米范围内）靠近目标
• 绝地潜兵必须向目标位置靠近。
使用战略配备：超级地球旗帜

升旗中
• 绝地潜兵必须等待并防守旗帜，抵御持续的虫洞爆发/机器人空投，持续 1 分 40 秒直到目标完成。
• 旗帜完全升起后，必须杀光目标附近的所有敌人才能完成任务。
• 若所有绝地潜兵在任务完成前离开旗帜区域，旗帜进度将开始倒退。

tasks.name: Stalker Lair
steps:
Destroy Stalker Lair
• There are 1-2 unique Bug Hole structures around the Stalker Nest. They can be destroyed in the same manner as any other bug hole.
Reward: 200 Requisition Slips & 50 Experience
tasks.tactical_info: Stalker holes can only be destroyed in two ways: Damaging the inside of the bug hole: With a minimum demolition force of 20 , which requires an explosive damage type. With a minimum demolition force of 30 , which does not require explosive damage specifically. Damaging the outside of the bug hole: With a demolition force of 40 or greater. A single well placed TED-63 Dynamite grenade can destroy 2 holes. Helldivers should immediately destroy these Lairs, as Stalkers are one of the most dangerous enemy types. Stalkers Lairs can also spawn small Terminids such as Scavengers . Stalker Lair holes are the same holes that can be found in Terminid Nests , their only difference is a slightly larger bug hole. They can be destroyed the same way. Helldivers can easily locate Stalker Lairs by searching in the direction Stalkers are coming from, and looking for the orange glow of the bug holes.
steps_zh:
摧毁追踪虫巢穴
• 追踪虫巢穴周围有 1-2 个独特的虫洞结构。它们可以用与任何其他虫洞相同的方式摧毁。
奖励：200 申购点和 50 经验
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 追踪虫洞只能以两种方式摧毁：从虫洞内部造成伤害：需要最低 20 拆毁力，且需要爆炸伤害类型。需要最低 30 拆毁力，不要求特定爆炸伤害。从虫洞外部造成伤害：需要 40 或更高拆毁力。单个放置得当的 TED-63 炸药可以摧毁 2 个洞。绝地潜兵应立即摧毁这些巢穴，因为追踪虫是最危险的敌人类型之一。追踪虫巢穴也能生成小型终结族，如食腐虫。追踪虫巢穴的洞与终结族巢穴中的洞相同，唯一区别是虫洞稍大。它们可以用相同方式摧毁。绝地潜兵可以通过搜索追踪虫来袭的方向，并寻找虫洞的橙色光芒来轻松定位追踪虫巢穴。

tasks.name: Stratagem Jammer
steps:
Destroy Automaton Stratagem Jammer.
• If SEAF Artillery is available, Mini-Nuke & High-Yield Explosive can hit nearby, while Explosive, Napalm, Static Field & Smoke shells must hit the jammer directly to destroy it. This can be done while the jammer is either active or disabled.
• Helldivers must interact with the terminal at the base of the Jammer to disable it, then call in a Hellbomb or a Stratagem with minimum demolition force of 50 of their choosing to destroy it.
Reward: 200 Requisition Slips & 50 Experience
tasks.tactical_info: The building that needs to be demolished requires a demolition force of 50 , which means it can be destroyed by other means than a NUX-223 Hellbomb . A recommended tactic is to fire the MS-11 Solo Silo at the jammer to wipe out any static enemies within the outpost to facilitate the raid into the structure. Should the entire squad perish within the range of Stratagem Jammer, the Reinforce stratagem will be automatically deployed by the edge of the jamming radius, towards the center of the mission area. A smart tactic some Helldivers use is to bait a Cannon Turrets , Annihilator Tanks , Factory Striders , or Vox Engines into shooting them with the structure behind them, but taking cover immediately so they will shoot and destroy the structure as their powerful lasers have a demolition force of 50. The Eagle 500kg Bomb , Orbital Precision Strike , Orbital 120mm HE Barrage , Orbital 380mm HE Barrage , or Orbital Walking Barrage can be used destroy the jammer when it is deactivated. Additionally The Orbital Gas Strike , Orbital EMS Strike , Orbital Smoke Strike and Orbital Railcannon Strike all have the capacity to destroy the jammer, requiring a direct hit. SEAF Artillery: Mini-Nuke, High-Yield Explosive, Explosive, Napalm, Smoke and Static Field as well as the B-100 Portable Hellbomb can destroy the jammer without disabling it. Napalm, Smoke & Static Field require a direct hit. If any stratagem balls are thrown into the range of the jammer, they will neither activate nor enter into a cooldown period. Throwing the Stratagem ball of the Orbital Walking Barrage just outside of the Jammer's radius will still allow the barrages shells to land inside the jammers range. If the barrage is faced directly towards the jammer, it is even possible to destroy it (albeit slowly) with the last few shells. It is possible for multiple jammers to spawn within the 150m jamming range of each other. This means that to destroy them, you must interact with the terminals of both of them to disable both jammers before Helldivers can call in a NUX-223 Hellbomb to destroy them, use a B-100 Portable Hellbomb to destroy one so the other can be destroyed by either mission hellbomb or other demo 50 stratagems or use SEAF Artillery.
steps_zh:
摧毁机器人战略配备干扰器。
• 如果 SEAF 火炮可用，迷你核弹和高爆弹可以命中附近，而爆炸弹、凝固汽油弹、静电场和烟雾弹必须直接命中干扰器才能摧毁。这可以在干扰器激活或禁用时进行。
• 绝地潜兵必须与干扰器底部的终端交互以禁用它，然后呼叫地狱火炸弹或选择具有最低 50 拆毁力的战略配备来摧毁它。
奖励：200 申购点和 50 经验
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 需要拆除的建筑需要 50 拆毁力，这意味着它可以通过 NUX-223 地狱火炸弹以外的方式摧毁。一个推荐的战术是向干扰器发射 MS-11 单兵导弹发射井，以清除前哨内的任何静态敌人，便于突入结构。如果整个小队在战略配备干扰器范围内阵亡，增援战略配备将自动部署在干扰半径的边缘，朝向任务区域中心。一些绝地潜兵使用的聪明战术是诱使加农炮炮塔、湮灭坦克、移动工厂或噪轰引擎向它们身后的结构射击，但立即躲到掩体后，这样它们会射击并摧毁该结构，因为其强大的激光具有 50 拆毁力。飞鹰 500kg 炸弹、轨道精准攻击、轨道 120mm 高爆弹火力网、轨道 380mm 高爆弹火力网或轨道游走火力网可以在干扰器被禁用时用于摧毁它。此外，轨道毒气攻击、轨道电磁冲击波攻击、轨道烟雾攻击和轨道炮攻击都有能力摧毁干扰器，需要直接命中。SEAF 火炮：迷你核弹、高爆弹、爆炸弹、凝固汽油弹、烟雾和静电场以及 B-100 便携式地狱火炸弹可以在不禁用的情况下摧毁干扰器。凝固汽油弹、烟雾和静电场需要直接命中。如果任何战略配备球被投掷到干扰器范围内，它们既不会激活也不会进入冷却。将轨道游走火力网的战略配备球投掷在干扰器半径外，仍然可以让火力网的炮弹落在干扰器范围内。如果火力网直接朝向干扰器，甚至有可能（尽管缓慢地）用最后几发炮弹摧毁它。多个干扰器可能生成在彼此 150 米干扰范围内。这意味着要摧毁它们，你必须与两者的终端交互以禁用两个干扰器，然后绝地潜兵才能呼叫 NUX-223 地狱火炸弹来摧毁它们，或使用 B-100 便携式地狱火炸弹摧毁一个，以便另一个可以被任务地狱火炸弹或其他 50 拆毁力战略配备摧毁，或使用 SEAF 火炮。

tasks.name: Terminate Illegal Broadcast
steps: Locate broadcast tower

Login required
• Input the arrow code to gain access.

Raise signal strength to 100%
• Align the signal to 100% to shut down the broadcast.
Reward: 200 Requisition Slips , 50 Experience
tasks.tactical_info: Instead of shutting down the broadcast with the terminal, the tower itself can be destroyed with any source of Demolition equal to or higher than 30 to instantly complete the objective. Examples include most grenades , the AC-8 Autocannon , GL-21 Grenade Launcher , and R-36 Eruptor . Any part of the tower except the mounted screens and speakers will trigger its destruction when hit. Most offensive Stratagems such as the Orbital Gatling Barrage and Eagle Strafing Run will work as well. Ramming the tower's base with a vehicle like the M-102 Fast Recon Vehicle , TD-220 Bastion MK XVI , or any Exosuit will also destroy it.
steps_zh: 定位广播塔

需要登录
• 输入箭头代码以获取访问权限。

将信号强度提升至 100%
• 将信号对齐到 100% 以关闭广播。
奖励：200 申购点、50 经验
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 除了用终端关闭广播外，塔本身也可以用任何拆毁值达到或超过 30 的武器摧毁，从而立即完成任务。例如大多数手榴弹、AC-8 机炮、GL-21 榴弹发射器和 R-36 爆裂铳。塔的任何部位（除安装的屏幕和扬声器外）被击中都会触发其摧毁。轨道加特林攻击和飞鹰机枪扫射等大多数攻击型战略配备也有效。用 M-102 快速侦察载具、TD-220 堡垒 MK-XVI 或任何外骨骼装甲撞击塔基也能将其摧毁。

tasks.name: Upload Escape Pod Data
steps:
Use Upload Data stratagem to begin upload
• The stratagem becomes available when within 30 meters of the crash site.
• It has the following code:

Protect (Helldiver) during upload
• (Helldiver) is the username of whoever began the upload.
• The upload will take 40 seconds. If the uploader dies or leaves the 30 meter radius, the upload progress will drain.
tasks.tactical_info: Beginning the upload process will reset the enemy reinforcement cooldown. Enemies will never spawn near the crashed escape pod. This makes it a good candidate for an initial drop location if it is visible during mission briefing.
steps_zh:
使用上传数据战略配备开始上传
• 该战略配备在距离坠机地点 30 米内时可用。
• 其代码为：

上传期间保护（绝地潜兵）
• （绝地潜兵）是开始上传者的用户名。
• 上传需要 40 秒。如果上传者死亡或离开 30 米半径，上传进度会流失。
tasks.tactical_info_zh: 开始上传过程会重置敌方增援冷却。敌人永远不会在坠毁的逃生舱附近生成。如果在任务简报中可见，这使其成为不错的初始降落点候选。
